description.en: A small enrolled Agnostus reconstruction with two free thoracic segments and nine appendage pairs. It represents the first holaspid stage; missing shield edges and limbs are conservatively restored, fine setae simplified and colour unknown.
description.zh: 小型卷曲Agnostus复原，具有两枚游离胸节和九对附肢，表现首个holaspid阶段。缺失盾缘与附肢保守补配，细刚毛简化，活体颜色未知。

anatomy: Broad near-round cephalic shield with smooth fields, modest axial glabellar lobation and narrow rim; no large dorsal compound eyes. Tiny uncertain ventral frontal organs must not become eyes on stalks.

Pygidium almost matching headshape andsize, axial raised area and short paired marginal spines. Two separate narrow articulating thoracic tergites link shields; count only free tergites, not pygidial fused subdivisions.

Moderately gaping enrolled posture based on Fig16B-C, about60degrees opening allows limbs and hinge to remain visible. Not a bivalve with lateralhinge and not flattened fully outstretched contrary to enrollment anatomy.

Four cephalic appendage pairs total: I sigmoidal antennules, II strong multisegmented setose exopod with absent/reduced endopod, III biramous with segmented endopod andstrong exopod, IV smaller biramous leg with club-like endopodalpart.
Five trunk appendage pairs decrease posteriorly, with lastone developed smallleg inh1 rather than meraspidbud. Anterior trunklegs biramous; keep compactundershields, no enormous spiderlegs.
Setae represented by limited broadreadable filaments rather than individual microscopic hairs. Anatomical left-right pairs, no moderncrustacean accessory claw orlongtail.
Muted matte warm-gray shell and softunderside are artistic, not originalcolor evidence.
restoration_boundaries: Plate5allimages are UB822 actual SEM; shield edge partlyremoved andfrontbroken. Fig2 is author h1reconstruction, notadditionalphotograph.
Fig6 late-meraspid appendages are used only as declared neighboring-stage anatomical supplement; text states small changes toh1 andninepairs inh1. Lasttrunklimb h1 is developed beyondbud.
Do not use stage1bphoto from2009 as two-thoracic main specimen. Do not claim UB87fromanothercrustaceanpaper as Agnostus.
No rigid fullunrolling toshowalllimbs; gapingposture preserves completeanimal anddistincttwojointedtergites.
Exact distalantennule count, microsetae, missingtip lengths andsoftbodycontour inferred.

scale.uncertainty: Published UB822shield measurements anchor micro-scale. Totalestimate is not directspecimenlength; use camera fitting, never multiply geometry scale tolooklarger.

scientific_limits.en: UB822 is the actual first-holaspid anatomical anchor, with published cephalic shield840x820micrometers and partial ventral preservation. Missing border and appendages are reconstructed from same-species h1 reconstruction and adjacent late-meraspid anatomy, not claimed preserved on UB822. Two free thoracic tergites are genuine h1 morphology, not one-segment meraspis. Body total if unfolded about1.8mm is an estimate; modeled gaping span differs. Appendage microsetae simplified, coloration unknown.
scientific_limits.zh: 实际主锚UB822为首个holaspid，论文头盾840×820微米，腹面仅部分保存。缺失盾缘及附肢按同种h1复原和相邻晚meraspid阶段保守补配，不称UB822全部保存。两枚游离胸节是h1真实形态，不以一胸节幼体替代。若展开全长约1.8毫米仅估计，张口卷曲姿态包围尺寸不同。细微刚毛简化，活体颜色未知。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete first holaspid living reconstruction with matching rounded cephalic and pygidial shields, exactly two liberated thoracic tergites and nine appendage pairs; moderately gaping enrolled posture rather than a featureless closed shell.

reference_credits.title: Muller and Walossek1987, Morphology, ontogeny, and life habit of Agnostus pisiformis, Fossils and Strata19

description.en: A complete hadrosaur reconstruction with an expanded tall cranial crest rather than the obsolete narrow rod. The crest combines incomplete material; missing regions, soft tissues, colour and stance are reconstructed.
description.zh: 完整鸭嘴龙类复原，采用扩展高头冠而非过时的细棒冠。头冠综合不完整材料，缺失部位、软组织、颜色与站姿为复原。

diagnostic_targets: Tall expanded lobate cranial crest with broad rounded summit and continuous connection toward snout, not solitary thin unicorn spike.
Follow2020Fig4: slightly rostrally inclined nasal support and subhorizontal caudal skull roof, not2013 posterior tilt.
Crest narrow across head in frontal view but broad in lateral view; not Corythosaurus round helmet or Parasaurolophus long back tube.
Duckbill, deep hadrosaur trunk, substantial hindlimbs, shorter forelimbs and long tapering tail.
Palms inward/functional supported forefeet without historical splayed pronated grasping hands.

scale.basis: NHM genus estimate; not measured IVPP individual or modern reconstructed crest.

scientific_limits.en: Crest reconstruction synthesizes multiple fragmentary specimens, not a complete preserved crest. Follow Zhang etal2020 Fig4 expanded crest with more rostrally inclined nasal and near-horizontal rear skull roof; white areas are reconstructed. CT shows nasal spine itself solid/sandwich-like, not a hollow pipe; this does not disprove the larger hollow crest. Body mount is composite and historically posed, with obsolete rod crest and pronated hands not adopted.12m is NHM genus estimate, not measured photographed skeleton. Soft tissue, colour and posture inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: 头冠整合多个零碎标本，不是保存完整头冠。采用Zhang等2020图4较向前倾鼻突和较水平后头顶的扩展高冠，白色缺失部位为复原。CT说明鼻突骨本身为实心夹层而非空管，不等于否定整体中空头冠。躯体装架为合成及历史姿势，旧棒冠和旋前手不采用。12米为NHM属估，非照片骨架实测。软组织、颜色及站姿为推定。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete hadrosaur with modern expanded tall cranial crest, dedicated2013/2020 form review, full trunk, four limbs and long tail. Never obsolete unicorn rod or skull-only object.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed2013Fig2 IVPPV725/V829 fossil photographs andFig7 reconstructed skull;2020Fig4 revised interpretation;2008Captmondo museum composite mount for torso/limb context only.

description.en: A conservative living Elrathia reconstruction with an oval dorsal shield, closely repeated thoracic ribs and a small tail shield. Ventral limbs are comparative restorations, not soft tissues preserved in the anchor fossil; colour and fine details are uncertain.
description.zh: 保守的Elrathia活体复原，具有椭圆背甲、紧密胸部肋节与小尾盾。腹肢为比较复原，并非主锚化石保存的软组织；颜色和细部仍不确定。

anatomy: Plain oval outline with semicircular broad head, modest central glabella, small lateral compound eyes and short genalpoints. No elaborate knobs, hugeeyes orlongcephalicspines.

Thirteen closely spaced free thoracic tergites, narrowraised centralaxis and broader flattenedpleuralribs; simple short swept-back tips, no tall axialspines. Adult13segmentcondition supportedbyBright1959 andHopkins2021; notallontogeneticstagesidentical.
Small rounded pygidium, narrowfaintraisedaxialarea andsmoothoutermargin; no longtailspike orradiatingtailspines. Fusedpygidialrings must not be counted as additionalfree thoracictergites.
Paired slender antennules underfronthead and three smallpostantennularcephalic limb pairs conservatively restored frompolymeridtrilobitebodyplan.
One paired biramous limb unit under eachof13thoracicsegments, endopodwalkingramus and restrainedouterfilamentbranch. Keepunderpleurae, notgills onback orhugeexposed shrimp paddles.
Four progressively smaller pygidial limb pairs are anexplicit visualizationchoice, notameasuredspeciescount. Keepmostlyundershield andsimplified; precise hiddenmicroanatomynotclaimed.
Subduedslate/earthtone livecolors areartistic, notblackfossilpreservation orstone texture. Fullbody withlowwalkingclearance, noattachedrock.
restoration_boundaries: Primary reference islargerPRI76837specimen shownatupperleft inviewedpreview; smallerindividual onlycontext, notmixedscale.
Onlydorsaltest directlysupported byPRIimage. Allventralbodyandappendages group-informed, withuncertainty preserved inpublicdescription.
Bright1959abstractreportsusual13thoracicsegments andfourvisibleaxialpygidialsegments; publishedsegmentinterpretations vary, do not equate visibleaxialrings withprovenlimbcount.
Houetal2021Triarthrus/Olenoides evidence onlysupports generalbiramousventralorganization; do notborrowTriarthrus14thoracicsegments orassertidenticalfinegillattachment.
Originalplainoval+ribs+smallroundtailgate retained, no dramaticrecolor/pose substitutefordistinctanatomy.

scale.uncertainty: Museum approximate length forlargerindividual, remainingratios estimatedfromobliqueimage; notorthographicmetrology. Do not scale fromsmallerspecimen orslab.

scientific_limits.en: PRI76837 contains two fossils. The museum gives approximately40mm for the larger and30mm for the smaller; only the larger anchors this model. Viewed image is a museum fossil-scan preview, not a photograph of living anatomy. Ventral appendages are not visible and are explicitly group-informed restoration, not preserved PRI soft parts. Exact pygidial limb count, thickness, posture, fine setae and color are uncertain.
scientific_limits.zh: PRI76837包含两件化石；馆方大件约40毫米、小件约30毫米，本模型仅用大件作尺度锚。已看图为馆藏实物扫描预览，非活体照片。腹肢不可见，明确属于三叶虫类群层级的保守补配，不是PRI实存软组织；尾盾腹肢精确数、体厚、姿态、细毛与颜色不确定。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete conservative living Elrathia centered on the larger individual of museum specimen group PRI76837: plain oval dorsal test, closely repeated thoracic ribs and small rounded pygidium; restrained inferred ventral limbs, not fossil slab.

description.en: A whole Daeodon reconstruction with a very large deep head, expanded cheek flanges and a comparatively narrow torso. The skeletal mount anchors the form; lips, skin, ears, tail and colour are inferred.
description.zh: Daeodon的完整复原，具有巨大深厚头部、扩展颊突与相对狭窄躯干。以骨骼装架为形态依据，唇、皮肤、耳尾和颜色为推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Artiodactyla, Entelodontidae; Dinohyus hollandi historical synonym, not modern Suidae.
diagnostic_targets: Huge elongated deep skull with strongly expanded paired lateral cheek arches/flanges.
Small chin tubercle only, no Archaeotherium-like huge anterior chin bosses.
Comparatively narrow deep torso supported by four relatively long legs and paired central hooves.
High shoulder support and substantial neck for heavy head, avoid giant round domestic pig torso.
Modest mouth opening reveals conical teeth/canines without exaggerated warthog curling tusks.
Complete body and narrow shortish tail, restrained inferred skin/ears/color.

scale.status: Tooth measurements directly reported Table2 p431; museumheight approximate; all other dimensions artistic estimates, not newly measured skeleton or species mean.

scientific_limits.en: CM1594 mounted fossil is the form anchor, not historical soft-tissue sculpture CM2503. Museum approximately six feet shoulder height is an estimate, not exact bone measurement. Lucas etal1998 CM1594 tooth lengths are directly reported; body dimensions selected below are modeling estimates. Cheek flanges are not the huge anterior chin tubercles of Archaeotherium: CM1594 has only a small chin tubercle. Lips, skin, ears, tail flesh, color inferred. No literal giant domestic pig, no certainty about all modern phylogenetic details.
scientific_limits.zh: 以CM1594真实展骨为形态锚，不用CM2503历史皮肤像。博物馆约六英尺肩高是估值非精确骨测；1998论文CM1594牙尺寸为报告值，全体参数另为美术估计。宽颊突不等于Archaeotherium巨大前下颏瘤，CM1594仅小下颏结节；唇皮耳尾色推定，不造巨型家猪。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete animal with very large deep head, expanded lateral cheek flanges and comparatively narrow torso. Anchor CM1594 skeleton, not historical skin sculpture CM2503.

reference_credits.title: Dinohyus: Terrible Pig in More Ways Than One
Taxonomy and distribution of Daeodon, an Oligocene-Miocene entelodont from North America

description.en: A small long-armed tyrannosauroid reconstruction with three-fingered hands and a filamented body outline. Filament evidence comes from a separate, tentatively assigned specimen; wider coverage, density and colour are extrapolated.
description.zh: 小型长臂暴龙超科复原，具有三指手和丝状体被轮廓。体被证据来自另一件暂定归属标本，更广的覆盖范围、密度与颜色为外推。

diagnostic_targets: Light small biped with proportionally long neck and trunk, slender balancing tail.
Long forearms with three discrete clawed digits each, not tiny two-fingered derived tyrannosaur hands; palms inward.
Short filament tufts break body and tail silhouette; branching filament reference, not broad aerodynamic wing feathers or a bird tail fan.
Relatively low lightly built skull with modest Y-shaped nasal/lacrimal ridge, not deep Tyrannosaurus skull or tall Guanlong crest.
Complete body retains forelimb negative space and readable joint transitions.

scale.basis: Xu etal2004 estimate for largest known specimen IVPP V14243, not complete living measurement.

scientific_limits.en: V14243 skull and skeletal anatomy and1.6m estimate anchor reconstruction, not a measured living adult. Filament evidence is from V11579, provisionally referred to D.paradoxus in2004 but possibly a second closely related Dilong species. Do not claim same specimen or certain same species. Filaments preserved by distal tail and posterior mandible; coverage elsewhere, density, colours and soft tissue inferred. Fig2 shows fragmentary V11579 preserved bones inside restored silhouette; not a complete fossil.
scientific_limits.zh: V14243头骨和骨骼及1.6米估值为主锚，非活体成年实测。丝状体被来自V11579，2004暂归D.paradoxus但原文明言可能另一近缘帝龙种，不冒称同一标本或确定同种。实际体被在尾远端及后下颌附近，其余覆盖、密度、颜色和软组织为外推。图2仅显示V11579部分已知骨骼，其完整轮廓为复原。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete small long-armed tyrannosauroid with filamented body outline, three-fingered hands, full trunk, legs and balancing tail.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Xu etal2004 Fig1 V14243 skull and humerus photos/drawings, Fig2 V11579 partial skeletal diagram and Fig3 V11579 actual filament photographs.

description.en: A whole living Aspidorhynchus acutirostris reconstruction without associated prey or a fossil slab. Body width, fin spread, missing margins and colour are inferred; the chosen scale is representative, not a measurement of the anchor specimen.
description.zh: Aspidorhynchus acutirostris的完整活体复原，不含伴生猎物或岩板。体宽、鳍展开、缺失边缘和颜色为推断；选定尺度是代表估值，并非主锚标本实测。

morphology: Long slender fish body with clearly pointed upper rostrum extending substantially beyond shorter lower jaw. Keep short lower-tip visible in lateral and perspective even with neutral almost closed mouth.

Head posterior to rostrum retains visible eye and opercular volume; rostrum is integrated premaxillary extension, not a detached horn or sawblade. Small teeth optional at low-poly scale, never fake huge shark jaws.

Single small dorsal and anal fins opposite each other far back near caudal peduncle, supported by museum account; not centered tall shark dorsal. Paired pectoral fins behind head and paired pelvic fins ventrally reconstructed conservatively.
Forked caudal fin vertically oriented, not horizontal whale fluke; slender peduncle. Broad lateral ganoid scale rows may be suggested with restrained facets rather than separate armor plates.
Neutral straight or very gently curved swimming posture. Restore living body thickness from flattened fossil, retain slender depth. No death entanglement, slab, pterosaur or extra animal.
Neutral muted grey/olive dorsal and light ventral color is artistic. Do not rely on color, name, scale or pose for distinctness.

scale.published_basis: Lopez-Arbarello and Schroeder 2013/2014 diagnosis: species up to c.80cm SL, neotype c.40cm SL. Neither value measures WDC CSG255.
scale.standard_length_definition: Premaxillary tip to caudal-fin base; total to longest caudal ray.
scale.target_limits: All component dimensions are approximate modeling targets, not specimen measurements. Upper extension/head length0.32 uses published species diagnosis30–36%; use whole head length including rostrum. Do not interpret as 32% total animal length.

scientific_limits.en: The photographs show laterally flattened articulated fossils, not living tissue. Body thickness, fin spread, missing or obscured fin margins, paired-side symmetry, eye contour and color are inferred. WDC CSG255 has no usable absolute scale in the retained Figure1; nominal 0.80m standard length is a representative species-scale choice, NOT a measurement of WDC CSG255. Published species maximum standard length is approximately0.80m; neotype standard length approximately0.40m. Standard length excludes caudal fin, so estimated modeled total length0.90m is a separate inference. Do not copy the trapped pterosaur or curved taphonomic posture. No unsupported genus-wide behavioral claim.
scientific_limits.zh: 照片为侧扁保存化石，不是活体软组织。体宽、鳍展开及遮挡/缺失鳍缘、对侧对称、眼球与颜色推定。WDC CSG255所留图1无可用绝对尺；0.80米标准长是同种代表尺度选值，不是该标本实测。文献种最大标准长约0.80米，新模标准长约0.40米。标准长不含尾鳍，模型约0.90米全长另外推定。不得复制被缠翼龙或埋藏弯曲姿态。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Aspidorhynchus acutirostris, anchored to WDC CSG255 with same-species neotype BSPG2012 I1 comparison. Only the fish is modeled, without prey, pterosaur, slab or fossil pose. Original genus-level target does not mandate another species or specimen.

acceptance: Front lateral: upper rostrum extends beyond lower tip about0.30–0.36headlength; full fish silhouette and separate lower tip remain readable.
Top: narrow integrated rostrum with fuller head/body behind, bilateral fin roots and tapering peduncle.
Side head-on: inferred modest body thickness, not flattened slab; no rostral horn disconnected from head.
Perspective: whole animal fits and unequal jaws remain visible at useful image scale. A small mouth gap is allowed for legibility, not extreme gape.
shape_gate.original_required_combination: Shape criterion: projecting pointed upper rostrum above a shorter lower jaw. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.

original_requirements_audit.selected_species_verified: WDC CSG255 listed under A.acutirostris in 2013 revision; BSPG2012 I1 is neotype.

shape_gate.visible_comparison: Retained WDC Fig1B and museum neotype image show projecting upper tip and shorter lower tip. Compare candidate directly in lateral view against these actual references; equal-jawed needlefish silhouette fails. This is not a claim of a supplied second 3D model.

specimen_lock.comparison: BSPG2012 I1, same-species neotype, not substitution
specimen_lock.original_lock: Original required selecting a species/specimen; no preassigned species, specimen or named three-way comparison.

description.en: A whole-animal reconstruction with a long neck, long legs, three-toed feet and a short mobile muzzle. Retracted bony nostrils do not establish trunk length; the soft nose, skin, ears, tail and colour are conservative inferences.
description.zh: 完整活体复原，具有长颈长腿、三趾足与短活动吻。后移的骨性鼻孔不能确定鼻长，软鼻、皮肤、耳尾及颜色为保守推断。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Panperissodactyla, Litopterna, Macraucheniidae; not camel or elephant.
diagnostic_targets: Long curved upright neck distinct from trunk-like muzzle; clear cervical transition at shoulder.
Long weight-bearing four limbs with visible joint transitions and three compact toes each, not camel two-toed feet.
Elongate skull with high retracted nasal zone distinct from ordinary horse forward nostril; external short nasal pad conservatively inferred.
Moderately deep long torso with no camel hump, rhino horn, elephant tusks or long hanging proboscis.
Complete living animal with small inferred ears and tapering tail, not skeleton-only or head-only.

scale.status: Atlas values reported in2023 Table1 cm, independent specimen. Whole model dimensions estimates; no giant mass-to-length conversion.

scientific_limits.en: Composite living reconstruction based on NHM partial Darwin specimen and 2023 correct mounted skeleton comparison. Figure3C MLP12-14244 (text also prints12-1424) includes mount restoration. NHM about3m body length is estimated, not a measurement of photographed mount or atlas specimen. PIMUZ A/V5700 atlas measurements are separate. Retracted bony nasal aperture does not determine soft nostril position or trunk length; short mobile lip/nasal pad is conservative inference. Skin, ears, tail and color inferred. Do not use erroneous bovid atlas shown in Fig3A/AMNH14489.
scientific_limits.zh: 综合活体复原，NHM达尔文部分标本与2023正确展骨对照；Fig3C编号12-14244而正文亦作12-1424，含展架补配。约3米是NHM全体估计，不是照片或寰椎标本实测。PIMUZ5700寰椎尺寸单独列示。后移骨性鼻孔不能确定软鼻孔位置及鼻长，采用保守短活动上唇鼻垫推定。皮耳尾色推定；不得用Fig3A及AMNH14489的错误牛寰椎。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole animal: long camel-like neck, long legs, three-toed feet and raised retracted nasal region. Conservative short mobile muzzle, no assumed elongated trunk.

More than100 years of a mistake: on the anatomy of the atlas of the enigmatic Macrauchenia patachonica

description.en: A whole Pachycormus macropterus reconstruction with a compact fusiform body and long scythe-like pectoral fins. It combines same-species specimens; body width, fin spread, repaired tail tips and colour are inferred.
description.zh: Pachycormus macropterus的完整复原，具有紧凑纺锤体与镰刀状长胸鳍。综合同种标本，体宽、鳍展开、尾端补全和颜色为推断。

morphology: Compact fusiform fish body, deepest around shoulder/anterior trunk and tapering to narrow caudal peduncle. Not eel-like and not deep disc-shaped. Large head integrates into body with a short tapered snout.

Pair of substantial scythe-like pectoral fins attached low behind opercular region, gently swept backward with curved leading outline and concave trailing portion toward pointed tip. Actual complete M1395 fin is visible in Fig5; do not substitute a triangular shark flipper, straight paddle or huge wing.
Small dorsal fin on posterior half of trunk, anterior to the anal fin. Small anal near the tail. No pelvic fins, consistent with published genus diagnosis. No adipose fin or added dorsal finlets.

Deeply forked vertically oriented caudal fin, using published same-species morphology and M1393 rays; distal tips and precise edge reconstructed conservatively. Do not extrapolate giant sickle tail lobes from another pachycormid.

Short rostrum, sizable eye and gently domed posterior skull roof; maintain opercular transition. Small needle-like teeth may be simplified, no massive canine row. Near-closed mouth, neutral swimming pose.
Subtle rhombic scales may be suggested by facets; no protruding plate armor. Neutral grey/olive with lighter underside is artistic, not a taxonomic marker.

scale.basis: Cawley et al. specimen-series range. Selected0.65m is estimated representative total, not standard length or exact size of any chosen component specimen.
scale.precision_limit: Component numbers are approximate artist reconstruction targets, not measured fossil dimensions. Preserve natural scythe outline; do not elongate into unsupported sword or flying-fish wing merely to satisfy word long.

scientific_limits.en: Head, forebody, pectoral and caudal evidence comes from different same-species specimens, not a complete single skeleton. Body subdivisions, body width, fleshed contour, fin spread and repaired caudal tips are inferred. The selected0.65m total length is a representative reconstruction estimate within published23.5–85cm total-length range, not a measurement of an assembled specimen. BRLSI M1393 tail distal rays are broken at the nodule margin; its exact living edge is unknown. Caudal anatomy varies among referred material and taxonomic significance remains unresolved. Do not copy taphonomic distortion, cracks or plaster as living features. Color is artistic. The unavailable Cooper2023 whole-body image was not viewed or used as a visual anchor.
scientific_limits.zh: 头、前躯、胸鳍和尾部来自多个同种标本，并非单个完整骨架。躯干分段比例、体宽、软组织轮廓、鳍展开和尾端补全均推定。选定0.65米全长是在论文23.5–85厘米全长范围内的代表复原估值，不是组合标本实测。BRLSI M1393尾鳍末端被结核边界截断，准确活体边缘不明；不同归属材料尾骨差异的分类意义未定。不得把埋藏变形、裂隙或石膏当活体特征。颜色艺术推定。未取得的Cooper2023全体图未查看、未作视觉锚。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete living reconstruction of Pachycormus macropterus using explicitly combined same-species BRLSI anatomical evidence. Not a single specimen digital twin. Preserve whole fish, compact fusiform body and long scythe-like pectoral fins; no slab or exposed fossil skeleton.

acceptance: Lateral front: compact fusiform full body, short snout, dorsal anterior to anal and no pelvic fins.
Top: both scythe-like pectorals are separately legible beyond body with tapering curved tips and integrated roots; cannot be hidden against flank.
Head-on side: conservative reconstructed width and paired pectoral attachment, no paper-flat fossil slab.
Whole perspective: compact fusiform plus long scythe pectorals visibly coexist; label, palette or pose alone cannot establish gate.
shape_gate.comparison: Compare actual model pectoral outline against Cawley Fig5 and skull/forebody against Fig2/4, not merely this text. Against Aspidorhynchus-type slender unequal-jaw fish, compact body, short snout and substantial curved pectorals must remain different without color/name/scale. No external runtime model dependency.
shape_gate.original_required_combination: Shape criterion: compact fusiform body and long sickle-shaped pectoral fins. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.

original_requirements_audit.taxon_specific_evidence: Actual same-species complete pectoral and skull/forebody/tail evidence plus author fusiform diagnosis; composite explicitly disclosed.

specimen_lock.dorsal_anal: M1366 dorsal/M1341 anal described in same paper; anal fragmented
specimen_lock.head: BRLSI M1332 lateral and M1389 dorsal
specimen_lock.interval: Early Jurassic, lower Toarcian, marine Strawberry Bank, UK
specimen_lock.pectoral: BRLSI M1395 complete pectoral, Fig5; M1332 also described with complete pectoral
specimen_lock.primary_anatomical_series: BRLSI Strawberry Bank specimens described by Cawley et al.2018/2019

reference_credits.title: Cawley, Kriwet, Klug and Benton2018/2019: The stem group teleost Pachycormus from the Upper Lias of Strawberry Bank, UK

description.en: A short-headed bipedal reconstruction with featherlike body covering and a distinctly scaly long tail. It combines partial fossils; featherlike structures follow the original authors' interpretation, while density, colour, muscles and pose are inferred.
description.zh: 短头双足复原，具有羽状体被和明显覆鳞的长尾。综合部分化石，羽状结构沿用原作者解释；密度、颜色、肌肉与姿态为推断。

diagnostic_targets: Compact short skull and beaked herbivorous muzzle, short forelimbs, long hindlimbs and long tapering tail.
Fine short filament/featherlike tufts around head, neck and torso and proximal limbs; no flight-wing vanes.
Tail largely smooth-looking at distance but with readable rows of thin overlapping scales, not fluffy feather tail or thick armour.
Keep featherlike torso versus scaly-tail regional contrast clear in standard side/perspective views.
Neutral biped stance, palms inward; do not use large carnivorous teeth or raptor sickle claws.

scale.basis: Godefroit etal2014 descriptive approximate body length, composite anatomy not exact individual measurement.

scientific_limits.en: Primary description combines six partial skulls and many disarticulated skeletons; Fig1 whole skeleton is composite, not one complete fossil. Holotype skull INREC K3/109, other body/integument specimens separately identified.1.5m is approximate descriptive body length, not complete fossil measurement. Featherlike structures interpretation follows original authors; evolutionary homology debated. Density, colour, muscles and pose inferred; tail scales are thin epidermal structures, not osteoderms.
scientific_limits.zh: 原描述综合六件部分头骨及许多散离骨架，图1为合成复原非单件完整化石。正模头骨K3/109与其他体被标本分开。1.5米为概述体长估值，非完整标本实测。羽状结构解释依原作者，演化同源性仍有争论；密度、颜色、肌肉姿势推定。尾鳞薄而属表皮，不做骨甲。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole short-headed biped with featherlike body covering and distinctly scaly long tail, short forelimbs and elongated hindlimbs.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually viewed Fig1 composite skeleton and true holotype skull INREC K3/109; Fig2 tail scale K4/94 and K4/117 photos, head filaments K4/22 and thorax K4/33.

reference_credits.title: Godefroit etal2014 A Jurassic ornithischian dinosaur from Siberia with both feathers and scales
Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences original paper
Authors2014 response on integument interpretation

description.en: A complete genus-level Dalmanites reconstruction with cheek spines, eleven thoracic segments and a ribbed tail shield. Missing spine tips and ventral limbs are comparative restorations, not measured structures of one completely preserved animal.
description.zh: 属级Dalmanites完整复原，具有颊刺、十一节胸部和带肋尾盾。缺失刺端与腹肢为比较补配，并非单个完整保存动物的实测结构。

anatomy: Broad crescent cephalon with raised central glabella and paired prominent schizochroal eyes. A few separated lens facets can convey the eyes, not solid featureless domes.
Paired rear-swept cheek spines, restored conservatively toward thoracic segment7, based on genus diagnosis. Their exact PRI lengths are unknown; do not extend past tail shield.
Eleven free thoracic tergites with raised narrow axis and paired furrowed pleurae. Posterior pleural tips progressively sweep backwards.

Broad subtriangular ribbed pygidium, raised axis with approximately13 shallow rings and9 pleural furrows as a genus-informed simplification, not a PRI counted census. One median broad-based caudal spine extending about12mm beyond plate; no twin fork or radial tail fan.

Slender paired antennae inferred; three postantennal head limb pairs with first smaller than next two, inspired by same-genus preserved material. Do not portray antennae as fossil-preserved in either reference.

Eleven paired biramous thoracic appendages. Inner branches are walking limbs; outer branches restrained oval fans with membrane-connected filament ribs, not spirals or exposed back gills. Fine distal limb joints are conservatively completed.

Six diminishing paired pygidial limbs are an explicitly inferred rendering convention. Published comparator preserves at least three, and its tail is incomplete; do not claim six is measured or that dorsal ring number proves limb count.
Full living animal, low walking clearance. No rock slab, preserved fractures, internal gut display or exaggerated lateral appendages. Color artistic.
restoration_boundaries: Primary PRI76797 actual scan preview supplies dorsal body and scale, not preserved appendages or a demonstrated complete terminal spine.
Budil etal2008 Dalmanites diagnosis supplies cheek-spine and tail-mucro architecture; do not import its Zlichovaspis or Odontochile comparisons.

Siveter etal2021 OUMNH C.29611 is a different incomplete Dalmanites sp. with actual soft parts. Its antennae and distal limb ends are missing. Membrane-linked exopod structure is comparative, not identical species identification.
Shropshire SHCMS:G.02903 D.myops head preview was viewed only to understand eye relief; its61mm head/rock dimensions are NOT whole-animal or PRI scale and must not replace primary anchor.
All missing-extremity lengths, thickness, limb detail, posterior limb count and life colors remain inferred. Original complete-animal gate is retained, not reduced to a shell or fossil fragment.

scale.uncertainty: 50 mm refers to preserved museum specimen. Adding an approximately12 mm inferred terminal spine yields about62 mm restored length. Other measurements are construction estimates from oblique image and genus diagnosis, not direct metrology.

scientific_limits.en: PRI76797 is identified only to genus. Its approximately 50 mm preserved specimen length excludes rock; the caudal extremity is not clearly resolved in the viewed preview. The added caudal spine, cheek tips and ventral anatomy are genus-informed restoration, not measured PRI structures. Comparative Herefordshire appendages belong to a different, unnamed Dalmanites species, not proof of identical fine anatomy. Complete modeled length is estimated, not museum-measured.
scientific_limits.zh: PRI76797仅鉴定到属，馆方约50毫米为保存标本本体长度，不含岩石，已看预览无法明确尾刺末端。补出的尾刺、颊刺末端与腹肢为同属层级推定，非PRI实测结构。赫里福德郡腹肢属于另一未定种，不证明细节完全一致；模型复原全长为估计，非馆方实测。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete genus-level living reconstruction: crescent head and cheek spines, eleven thoracic tergites, broad ribbed tail shield with one median caudal spine. PRI76797 is the dorsal body and approximate size anchor; missing extremities and soft parts are explicitly comparative restoration, not a replica of one completely preserved animal.

description.en: Teleoceras proterum has a barrel-shaped trunk, short sturdy legs and a low head bearing a small nasal horn. Soft tissues, colour, pose and dimensions are artistic estimates informed by composite museum mounts, not an exact individual.
description.zh: Teleoceras proterum 具有桶状躯干、短而粗壮的四肢，以及带小鼻角的低位头部。软组织、颜色、姿态及尺寸是参考博物馆复合装架标本的艺术估计，并非精确个体复原。

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export views front/side/top/perspective; perspective may equal preview. No extra turntable or website-sized image until needed; independent reviewer judges original shape gate.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Inspect side, front and elevated oblique at low cost before final detail; reject if original inventory shape combination is absent. No automatic scientific PASS from numeric limits.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained earth tones, no reference-image embedding

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block short stout legs beneath an extremely barrel-shaped rhinoceros trunk with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织极桶状犀类躯干下方的短粗腿；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: short stout legs beneath an extremely barrel-shaped rhinoceros trunk. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：极桶状犀类躯干下方的短粗腿。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Neutral four-foot terrestrial stance, short lowered neck, slight head turn; all four limbs visually separable.

scale.basis: All dimensions are working artistic estimates, not specimen measurements.
scale.tolerance: Length ±10%; width/height are silhouette design targets not hard scientific measurement gates.

scientific_limits.en: Soft tissue, color, pose and unsourced dimensions are artistic estimates. Museum mounts may contain restored/composite elements; no specimen-exact anatomy or ecology is certified.

shape_requirements: Original combination: light early-dinosaur body, relatively short head and grasping forelimbs. Do not make a scaled Herrerasaurus or an elongated Coelophysis head/neck.
Slender bipedal trunk, long balancing tail and folded mobile forelimbs with separated grasping digits. Main claw-bearing fingers must read; do not replace hand with two-digit tyrannosaur mitten.
Relatively compact low skull with tapered muzzle and visible eye region, not a deep massive carnivore head. Preserve head-to-body balance before teeth details.
Maintain open elbow/torso and leg negative spaces, digitigrade rear feet and restrained horizontal balance; not upright kangaroo stance.

description.en: Coccosteus cuspidatus has compact jointed head armour and short trunk armour transitioning into a long flexible swimming body. Tail margins, fin outlines, thickness, colour and dimensions are inferred rather than fully preserved living anatomy.

construction_notes: Front armor seams should be shallow real geometry/facet boundaries; avoid copying fracture cracks from the MUSE fossil as anatomical sutures.
Keep pelvic fins as substantial lateral paired structures posterior to thoracic shield, not tiny belly triangles copied mechanically from older reconstructions. Exact web shape remains inferred.
Tail should be long enough for original gate but not eel-like; fossil ROM52664 supports tapering post-thoracic body, published skin outline is reconstructed.
Muted gray olive palette and still swimming pose are original art choices; no water scene, base or animation needed.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic adult envelope guided approximately by ROM figure scale; not a precise specimen measurement or maximum-size claim.

scientific_limits.en: Tail soft-tissue outline, fin web margins, thickness, color and dimensions are inferred artistic estimates. Published 2024 reconstruction explicitly uses extant shark analogues for tail margins. 2025 paired-fin research warns against obsolete tiny ventrally placed pelvic fins; its indexed abstract excerpt was read, not unavailable full text.
scientific_limits.zh: 尾部软组织轮廓、鳍膜边缘、厚度、颜色和尺寸均为推断性的艺术估计。2024 年发表的复原明确借鉴现生鲨鱼来推断尾部边缘。2025 年的成对鳍研究提醒，不应沿用过时的、过小且置于腹侧的腹鳍复原；所阅读的是检索索引中的摘要节选，并非未能取得的全文。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original Coccosteus cuspidatus living reconstruction, informed by fossil ROM VP52664 photograph and MUSE head armor; SM H4494 syntype catalogue supports identity and historical names. Not a specimen scan.
shape_requirements: Original compact jointed head armor on a long lightly armored swimming body must remain visible; not an all-armored box or a scaled Dunkleosteus.
Readable low head shield and short thoracic armor with a cranio-thoracic articulation break; taper into flexible long post-thoracic trunk and tail.
Paired pectoral and pelvic fins, dorsal fin and unequal caudal lobes supported by fossil/reconstruction context. Fin outlines are conservative estimates, not copied publication geometry.
Moderate fish mouth and distinct eyes; no enormous Dunkleosteus blades, needle jaws, horns or dense false armor on the rear body.
frozen_scientific_scope.taxon_scope: Coccosteus cuspidatus; historical Coccosteus decipiens/pusillus names checked

description.en: Mylodon darwinii has a long narrow head, low shaggy body and strong curved foreclaws. Whole-body proportions, fur distribution and colour are estimates; claw shape alone does not establish digging or burrowing behaviour.

construction_notes: Choose calm low quadrupedal stance to meet original body gate; do not copy the museum illustration's rearing pose.
Fossil skin has embedded ossicles, not an exposed armored shell. Represent shaggy outer coat, not naked pebble armor.
Warm gray/brown neutral color is an art choice, not reconstructed exact living pigment from preserved fur.
Published skull plate supports elongate bony muzzle only. Skin covers nasal bony structures; do not turn them into a decorative facial horn.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Length broadly follows NHM approximate3m; width/height and posture are artistic estimates, not a measured complete specimen.

scientific_limits.en: Whole-body proportions, low walking stance, fur length distribution, original color, claw curvature and soft muzzle are estimates. Preserved jaw and skin directly support only those tissues; published life reconstruction is interpretation. Original digging-claw wording is retained as a shape label, not proof of digging or burrowing behavior. Do not use old Mylodon robustus illustrations as M.darwinii anatomy.
scientific_limits.zh: 全身比例、低位行走姿态、各处毛长分布、原始颜色、爪弯曲度及软吻部均为估值。保存的颌骨与皮肤只直接支持相应组织；已发表的活体复原属于解释。保留原清单掘爪措辞作为形状标签，不把它当作挖掘或掘洞行为的证据。不得把旧名 Mylodon robustus 的图当作 M.darwinii 解剖依据。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original Mylodon darwinii living reconstruction informed by NHM holotype jaw and preserved skin photographs, Reinhardt1879 skull plate, and explicitly labelled NHM-published life reconstruction. Not a scan or a complete articulated fossil replica.
shape_requirements: Original long narrow head, low shaggy body and robust digging-shaped claws retained together. Claw geometry does not assert burrowing behavior.
Elongated tapering muzzle on a relatively small head, deep low trunk and strong limbs; not broad short Glossotherium muzzle or upright giant Megatherium silhouette.
Visible stout curved foreclaws separated from supporting paw surfaces; preserve leg gaps beneath shaggy belly.
Low coarse fur silhouette in restrained faceted masses; no dense hair particles or bear-like round face. Strong tapering tail remains subordinate.
frozen_scientific_scope.taxon_scope: Mylodon darwinii; historical Grypotherium darwini/Glossotherium darwini references distinguished from modern Glossotherium robustum

construction_notes: Sparse raised veins across thin closed wing meshes, not hundreds of rods. Keep wing outlines legible at final viewer distance.
Simplify incomplete distal venation; do not claim exact taxonomic vein map or copy modern dragonfly-specific detail unsupported by source.
Neutral dark brown body and muted lightly opaque wings are artistic. Calm wings-out resting pose, no prey or swamp scene.

modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以细长腹部配四片宽基翅及圆形捕食头部搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

shape_gate.en: Its distinguishing construction is long narrow abdomen with four broad-based veined wings and a rounded grasping head; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
shape_gate.zh: 以细长腹部配四片宽基翅及圆形捕食头部为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

scientific_limits.en: Head shape, mandibles, abdomen completion, limb proportions, wing membranes, color and posture are inferred where poorly preserved. scientific_limits.zh: 头形、颚、腹部补全、肢体比例、翅膜、颜色及姿态在保存不佳处均属推断。R51142化石直接支持翅与部分身体，而非完整活体轮廓。圆形捕食头部是原美术判据；该标本的精确头部细节并未确定。翼展为近似值而非精确测量。

shape_requirements: Original long narrow abdomen, four broad-based veined wings and rounded grasping head retained together.
Four separate gently tapering wing membranes attach in two pairs to thorax; broad wing bases and sparse branching vein geometry must read, not two solid airplane wings.
Small rounded head with paired eyes and restrained mandibular parts, six articulated legs with a few prey-grasping spine cues.
Long segmented tapering abdomen behind compact thorax; no wasp waist, butterfly fan wings, scorpion tail or giant fictional jaws.

art_direction.negative_space: Preserve separation between legs, upper tusks, lower shovel and trunk. Check thumbnail silhouette before detail.
art_direction.palette: Restrained warm grey-brown skin, darker crease/ear interior, warm ivory tusks, dark eyes and subdued nails. Colour is not a factual taxon claim.
art_direction.pose: Quiet planted four-foot stance, subtle fore/hind longitudinal offsets. Head nearly level with a slight natural downward tilt. Trunk lifted and offset to animal right just enough to expose both lower tusks. No vegetation, base, text, harness, or dramatic feeding scene.
art_direction.shape_language: Purposeful faceted lofts with carefully placed silhouette turns, not an assembly of untouched spheres, cubes or cylinders. Continuous visual flow at shoulder, chest, pelvis, cheek and trunk root.
art_direction.surface: Broad coherent low-poly planes on the torso; finer rings only at face, jaw waist, trunk curvature, ears and limb joints. No random triangle/noise colouring. Keep tusk surfaces cleaner than skin and avoid razor-thin zero-area geometry.

frozen_scientific_scope.budget_rationale: Target 6500–9500 exported triangles; the frozen 12000 ceiling allows deliberate head, trunk, ear and joint shaping. 24 exported primitives is a practical submission ceiling, not a request for 24 disconnected pieces. Do not spend the budget on unseen skull interiors or micro-wrinkles.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic representative adult envelope, not a measurement or allometric result. Keep metres, never unit-cube normalization.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-GLB front/side/top/perspective PNGs; preview may share identical perspective bytes. No default extra turntable. Add a head detail only if the four images cannot resolve a specific defect and record the reason.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Before final rendering, inspect 3–4 inexpensive grey checks including front, side, top and/or oblique. Stop to repair any indistinct lower tusk pair, trunk/shovel overlap, modern-elephant head or primitive-looking body.

material_profile.pbr: Opaque glTF-compatible Principled base colour, roughness and normal data; no source-only procedural texture dependency.
material_profile.shading: Intentional mixed faceted shading; smooth or weighted normals only where their exported result is verified.

frozen_scientific_scope.publication_scope: Preparation only. No model, independent acceptance, GPU success, user acceptance or publication is asserted.

required_features.criterion: Long lower jaw broadens from a narrow waist into a shallow spatulate platform. In top view it must not read as a narrow elephant chin or rounded duck bill.
required_features.test: Inspect top and oblique exact-export images; verify a deliberate waist-to-distal-width transition.

required_features.criterion: Exactly two flattened lower tusks occupy the front of the mandibular platform, with a narrow visible median seam, broad transverse distal cutting edges and a clear ivory/skin boundary. They are not two conical spikes, one fused plate, or a hanging beard.
required_features.test: Inspect front/top and silhouette at thumbnail size; ensure both tusks and their origin are legible.

required_features.criterion: A second, separate pair of slimmer upper tusks projects forward from the upper rostrum. Use the relatively straight/slightly down-directed male reference, not mammoth spirals or the downward lower hooks of Deinotherium.
required_features.test: Side and oblique views distinguish upper tusks, lower shovel and trunk without major occlusion.

required_features.criterion: A separate tapering flexible trunk originates above the upper rostrum. Its restrained offset curl leaves the lower cutting platform visible. Do not replace it with an enormous flat upper lip or merge it into the tusks.
required_features.test: Front, side and perspective views show a continuous root and clear separation; exact length/tip remain artistic.

required_features.criterion: Use the long, low cranial profile with a modest raised rear of the male skull; avoid a modern elephant forehead dome, juvenile oversized head, or female short-jaw substitution.
required_features.test: Compare the uncluttered lateral head outline to the male fossil plates.

required_features.criterion: Four weight-bearing limbs, readable shoulder/hip transitions, planted feet, belly clearance, modest ears and tapering tail support a plausible elephantiform body.
required_features.test: All four standard views; body details are constrained artistic design, not specimen facts.

required_later_checks: standalone exact-GLB audit and Khronos validation
two isolated rebuilds with declared package-local dependency closure and normalized semantic digest comparison
fresh independent visual, factual and specification review
public text and binary privacy inspection
manifest and real reader compatibility after independent PASS

runtime_profile.actual_gpu_and_scene: Must remain UNKNOWN unless separately measured. Technical or independent visual PASS cannot substitute.
runtime_profile.content: Static embedded-buffer GLB; meshes and organizational empties only; no rig, animation, external images, compression extension or required extension.
runtime_profile.intended_use: Museum catalog asset viewed as a complete animal; head remains readable under ordinary zoom. Not a simulation or osteological measurement model.

scientific_limits.en: The head is informed by fossils, principally HMV0940. The body envelope, ear shape, trunk length and pose, skin, colour, feet and tail are artistic reconstruction choices. Trunk function is inferred from skeletal morphology and functional analysis, not preserved soft tissue. The dorsal male jaw reference HMV0031 is a different individual. Do not combine female or juvenile proportions into the male design, claim an exact body size, or portray mud-shovelling as established behaviour.
scientific_limits.zh: 头部主要参照 HMV0940 化石。体躯范围、耳形、鼻长与姿态、皮肤、颜色、脚和尾均为艺术复原选择。鼻部功能来自骨骼形态与功能分析推断，并非保存的软组织。雄性下颌背视参考 HMV0031 属另一标本；不得混入雌性或幼体比例，不宣称精确体型，也不把铲泥解释成已确定行为。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original refined low-poly living reconstruction of an adult male Platybelodon grangeri, using HMV0940 as the cranial and mandibular proportion anchor and other explicitly identified adult male fossils only for complementary views. Not a scan, measured whole skeleton, exact individual, or claim that soft anatomy is preserved.

source_measurement_anchors.use: Published Table 1 and Table 2 skeletal measurement definitions. Use ratios for a coherent male head; do not equate skeletal dimensions to soft-tissue mesh extents or whole-body length.

comparison_only: HMV0930 in Li et al. 2024, sex not assumed here
HMV0023 and HMV0042 female specimens, not copied into target proportions
HMV1813 juvenile, not copied into target proportions
complementary_specimens: HMV0031 adult male mandible dorsal view
HMV0024 adult male skull anterior view
taxon_scope.locality_scope: Linxia Basin, China; no exact numerical age is asserted

frozen_scientific_scope.website_image_plan: No website-renderer/config source is pinned during preparation, so do not claim a generic perspective render satisfies the website 512 contract. Keep canonical views. Integration may produce only the specifically needed detail/wheel images under its verified current renderer.

description.en: Megacerops coloradensis has two unbranched bony nasal processes, with form principally guided by the AMNH 518 skeleton and skull. Species-level systematics remain debated; skin, horn covering, colour and dimensions are inferred, not exact specimen measurements.
description.zh: Megacerops coloradensis 具有两枚各自不分叉的骨性鼻突，形态主要参照 AMNH 518 骨架与头骨。种级分类仍有讨论；皮肤、角表覆盖物、颜色及尺寸为推断，而非精确标本测量。

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exactly two short robust nasal processes, separate tips and a clear central gap; no branches or tandem arrangement.
Recognizable long saddle-shaped skull envelope, high rear attachment and deep cheek/jaw; head does not become a generic modern rhino cube.
High shoulder mass slopes toward rump; robust but articulated limbs and readable negative spaces; no unmodified primitive assembly.
Four front and three rear toes on each side, subtle but inspectable; final top/front evidence must not hide their intended geometry.
Uncertain soft tissue, estimated scale and mixed reference scope are disclosed; no exact specimen, sex or behavior claim.
Clean joins, deliberately shaped planes, no holes or accidental intersections, grounded feet and uncropped tail/horns in exact-export views.

anti_targets: No distal bifurcation of either nasal process: the pair makes a broad V/slingshot silhouette, not four prongs.
No rhinoceros tandem midline horns, single keratin cone, trunk, elephant tusks, deer antlers or Embolotherium ram.
Do not derive dimensions from the image pixels or scale bars of unrelated specimens; do not copy a mounted jaw gape into the resting living pose.
Do not reproduce fracture, damaged fossil edges, restorations, metal supports or the artistic outline printed in the museum fact sheet.
No faceted ball torso with visibly intersecting spherical shoulder/hip attachments; resolve anatomical transitions with purposeful lofts.
frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia; Perissodactyla; Brontotheriidae. Not a rhinoceros.
construction_intent: Build torso and neck using nonuniform profile lofts with distinct chest, shoulder, lumbar and rump sections; use enough lateral samples to keep barrel curvature deliberate at close view.
Create the head from controlled longitudinal cross sections and explicit cheek/mandible planes. Preserve the concave dorsal saddle before adding small eyes, ears, nostrils and mouth seam.

Use curved tapered cross sections for paired nasal processes with thick shared frontonasal bases and rounded flattened tips. Match the short robust AMNH 518 character, not the tallest horn form in another specimen.
Legs need shoulder/elbow/carpal and hip/stifle/hock changes in thickness and angle. Join smoothly into torso skin while keeping leg gaps readable from the front and side.

Palette regions should follow anatomy: warm gray-brown main hide, slightly lighter flank/muzzle, darker feet and recesses. Horn covering remains a conservative skin-adjacent artistic material rather than a proven ivory or keratin sheath.
diagnostic_targets: Exactly two blunt, individually unbranched bony nasal processes beside one another on the frontonasal region, diverging outward and somewhat upward/forward. Their inner gap must read in front, top and perspective views.

Long heavy head with raised occipital/neck attachment, a concave saddle-like upper skull silhouette between the rear crest and nasal processes, a shortened blunt muzzle, deep cheek and substantial lower jaw.
Strong short neck flows into a high shoulder/withers mass; back descends gently toward lower hindquarters without an exaggerated camel hump or a steep toy-like wedge.
Deep barrel-shaped ribcage, restrained belly, robust upper limbs and more tapered lower limbs with visible joint placement; no four identical cylinders.
Four compact toe endings on each front foot and three on each hind foot, with shallow separations visible when inspected; not cloven hooves, single horse hooves or claws.
Living-animal skin envelope, small lateral ears and dark modest eyes with a readable lip line; no exposed skeleton, armor plates or museum support rods.
frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four canonical exact-GLB front/side/top/perspective images, with perspective reusable byte-for-byte as preview. Original technical checks, Khronos format validation, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent visual/factual review remain required.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Inspect 3-4 cheap gray/clay images from front, side, top or oblique before costly final rendering. Resolve horn gap, dorsal head saddle, shoulder height and foot count first. These are authoring diagnostics, not final GLB proof.

material_profile.surface: Deliberate faceted large and secondary planes; no glossy plastic, bone-white horns, fossil cracks, painted triangulation or random per-face noise.

pose.stance: Quiet standing quadruped with a small fore/hind longitudinal foot stagger, all four feet weight bearing. Head held below shoulder crest; muzzle roughly level to slightly downturned. No charging or fighting narrative.
pose.symmetry: Bilateral cranial anatomy; restrained asymmetric stance only, not asymmetrical horn count.
pose.tail: Short gently drooping tapered tail, clear of hind feet; modest terminal tuft is optional artistic inference.

frozen_scientific_scope.required_runtime_scope: Static standalone GLB with opaque mesh materials; no rig, animation, lights, cameras, external buffers or unapproved extensions. GPU, combined scene, user acceptance and deployment remain UNKNOWN unless separately observed.

scale.status: Representative artistic dimensions, not specimen measurements. NPS gives approximately 4.9 m length and 2.4 m height for Badlands animals; RSM gives approximately 4 m length and 2 m shoulder height for its genus-level example. The chosen intermediate envelope is not a new scientific size claim.

scientific_limits.en: AMNH 518 is historically labeled Brontops robustus; modern taxonomic context places unbranched-horn Chadronian forms within M. coloradensis, but species-level systematics remain debated. Mount restoration and perspective prevent exact measurements. Body size is a representative estimate, not measured from this individual. Skin thickness, horn covering, ears, lips, tail soft tissue, color and resting pose are artistic inferences. Two unbranched bony nasal processes are required; do not import the distally forked horns of M. kuwagatarhinus or the single ram of Embolotherium. No combat behavior, exact sex, coat pattern or precise body mass is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: AMNH 518 的历史展签使用 Brontops robustus；现代分类语境将晚始新世不分叉角型归入 M. coloradensis，但种级分类仍有讨论。展架补配与透视不支持精确测量。体型采用代表性估值，并非该个体实测。皮肤厚度、角表面覆盖、耳、唇、尾部软组织、颜色和静立姿势均属艺术推定。鼻前部必须是成对且各自不分叉的骨性突起，不得混入 M. kuwagatarhinus 的角端分叉或 Embolotherium 的单一撞槌。不得主张特定战斗方式、性别、毛色花纹或精确体重。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original refined-low-poly whole adult reconstruction of Megacerops coloradensis, with the AMNH 518 mounted skeleton and skull as the principal form anchor. Not a scan, an exact specimen replica, or a claim of known sex.

target_budget.reason: Spend topology on saddle-shaped head profile, rounded paired nasal processes, shoulder/neck transitions, leg joints and fourteen toe endings, not on a uniform subdivision or a field of primitive lumps.

texture_policy.reason: Shape-first original geometry with a small portable PBR palette. Reference photographs are not textures.

view_plan.extra_views: None by default; only add a specific unresolved toe or horn-base detail and record why.
view_plan.front: Camera on -Y; exposes paired nasal processes and forefoot count.
view_plan.perspective: Camera in +X,-Y,+Z quadrant; full body including tail, horn tips and all feet.
view_plan.side: Camera on +X; shows concave head profile, withers, back slope and limb transitions.
view_plan.top: Camera on +Z; shows side-by-side horn placement, lateral skull/shoulder width and foot gaps.

website_display.reuse_512_plan: Not promised at prep. Canonical perspective remains the evidence baseline; use a verified website 512 renderer/camera contract only if it is already available and still demonstrates the required features. Do not call a generic Blender 512 render website-compatible.
website_display.wheel_768x432: Defer to authorized integration; no maker-stage extra render.

It is a ceiling, not a polygon target. Eight materials and forty primitives retain editable semantic parts without excessive draw calls.

feature_obligations.criterion: Adult male giant-deer identity and huge bilateral antler-to-body relationship remain readable at thumbnail scale.
Palmation has irregular pointed margins, beam/pedicle transitions, a real curved volume and preserved negative spaces; no reconstruction of broken fossil edges as living antler tips.
Robust cervical/shoulder support integrates into a cervid trunk and long distal limbs without turning into moose or bison anatomy.
Coat palette, modest withers contour and exact antler branching are disclosed as interpretation; no claim to a measured individual.

frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Inspect low-cost front, side and elevated oblique views before final materials/renders; add top only if antler sweep or ear clearance remains unclear. scale.basis: Working artistic scale near museum-reported adult size. Only the approximate size class is evidence-backed; these exact model numbers are not specimen measurements.
scale.tolerance: Shoulder height ±8%; antler spread/shoulder height 1.55–1.80. Body proportions and crown depth remain shape-review targets, not fossil measurements.

scientific_limits.en: Body covering, coloration, stance, exact mass, antler point count and all unsourced dimensions are interpretive. Skeletal mounts may include restored parts; the Cork material is incomplete. Antler asymmetry and proportions varied among individuals. This design does not establish a fixed coat pattern, a precise shoulder hump profile, or an extinction cause/date.
scientific_limits.zh: 体表、颜色、站姿、确切体重、角尖数量及无测量来源的尺寸均为解释性设计。博物馆骨架可能含复原部分，科克标本不完整；个体鹿角形态存在差异。本设计不确定固定毛色纹样、精确肩隆轮廓或灭绝原因与日期。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original refined-low-poly living reconstruction of one adult male Megaloceros giganteus with fully grown bare antlers, informed by named museum skeletal references. A generalized animal, not a scan, specimen replica, phylogenetic diagnosis or measured anatomical restoration.
shape_requirements: Silhouette first: a very wide pair of palmated antlers above a robust but leggy cervid, not a moose with a bulbous drooping muzzle, reindeer with many thin twig branches, or a generic deer scaled up.

Each antler has a stout pedicle/beam connection, a curved lateral beam, a separated basal/brow projection and a broad flattened distal palm with a handful of unequal tapered points and deep readable notches. Use a shallow compound curve and finite thickness, never a paper plane, solid oval paddle, repeated triangular comb or ring of cones.

Keep palm faces readable from front/oblique views and their thickness/fore-aft sweep readable from top and side. Antlers must remain clear of the ears, skull and opposite antler; do not fill the large negative spaces with a solid plate.

A shaped chest, robust rising neck, modest elevated withers and lower rump form continuous deliberate transitions; the shoulder support must not become an exaggerated bison/camel hump. Use a leaner abdomen behind the deep rib cage.

An elongated cervid head narrows toward a small dark muzzle, with lateral eyes, two leaf-shaped ears below the antler bases, a defined jaw transition, small tail and four anatomically bent legs terminating in paired cloven hooves.

Resolve shoulders, hips, wrists/hocks and ankle taper with custom loft/profile topology. No assembly of untouched spheres, capsules or uniform cylinders for the body and limbs. All four limbs remain distinct and weight-bearing.

Original warm earth palette separated by material region, not random per-face noise. Body planes mostly quiet, with geometry concentrated in the muzzle, joints, antler beam-to-palm transition, notches and tips. Do not bake shadows or hide defects with dark materials.

texture_policy.reason: A restrained original palette is sufficient for this silhouette-led asset; geometry cannot be replaced by painted structure.

description.en: Fossil-informed Aegirocassis with two flap tiers and paired filtering appendages using the revised six-long-endite interpretation. Eyes, soft tissues, colour, pose and exact proportions are reconstructed; filtering setae are reduced and thickened, not a true mesh-size model. No tail fan is added.
description.zh: 依据化石复原的 Aegirocassis，保留双层侧叶及成对滤食附肢，采用六条长内叶的新解释。眼、软组织、颜色、姿态与精确比例属推定；滤食刚毛减少并加粗，不代表真实滤网孔径，不添加尾扇。

frozen_scientific_scope.budget_rationale: Allow the two flap tiers, tripartite shell and open paired filters to remain distinct. Aim for 6500–9500 triangles; spend on silhouette and sparse closed filter bristles rather than microscopic spinules. Caps are practical task budgets, not fossil facts.

context.interval: Early Ordovician; late Tremadocian reference material
context.locality: Lower Fezouata Shale, Ternata plain near Zagora, Morocco

design.colour_claim: Entire palette is an original artistic choice; fossil iron staining is not living pigmentation.
design.pose: Near-symmetric level swimming and active filtering; mild natural flap cant, no exaggerated attack curl. No stand, substrate, water effects, text or labels in the exported geometry.
design.style: Deliberate lofts and shaped fins, not a stack of untouched spheres or cones. Keep large shell, short broad trunk and hanging filter basket readable at thumbnail scale.
design.surface: Controlled facets on large shell/loft forms with clean edge changes; smooth or mixed normals on slender filtering structures. Matte portable PBR materials, no transparency-dependent net sheets.

dimensions.scale_note: Representative large animal within the reported greater-than-2 m size class, not a measured single individual. Do not unit-normalize.

frozen_scientific_scope.frozen_scope: Preparation-only freeze for a local fixed candidate. Maker, technical evidence, independent QA, GPU, scene, user and publication states must each be established separately.

morphology_requirements.requirement: Tripartite cephalic carapace: one long pointed, low-convex central shield with an axial keel and rounded broad rear, plus two separate oval lateral elements. Central shield approximately as long as the exposed trunk; it projects forward, not backward over half the trunk. Include modest downturned posterolateral extensions; do not make a helmet dome or bivalve enclosing the animal.

Broad low trunk, slight maximum width near segment 3, then taper to a short blunt segment 11. Preserve 11 discernible segments, with shallow intersegmental recesses. Ten flap-bearing segments; terminal 11th has no added flap pair.

On each of the first ten segments, retain distinct left/right dorsal AND ventral flaps: 20 dorsal plus 20 ventral. Dorsal fins are shorter, pointed and recurved; lower triangular paddles are longer with rounded tips. Separate their root heights and keep successive flaps non-overlapping in neutral pose. They must not read as a single scalloped ribbon.

Indicate transverse bands of setal blades across the back connected near dorsal flap bases, with blades running fore-aft. Simplify as low longitudinal ridges across each dorsal band. Do not mistake these bands for an extra row of fins.

Two frontal appendages beneath the head, each a short articulated upper shaft supporting one shorter proximal comb endite plus six long inward-curved blade-like endites. The first five long endites carry one dense-looking row of thin setae; the sixth has visibly shorter, thicker, curved setae. Preserve a gap and bilateral structure, while inward-canted endites form an open filter basket rather than raptorial claws or six bare rods.

Use representative sparse rows of solid setae with actual air gaps; do not model every biological seta or microspinule and do not claim exact filtering mesh size. Keep first-five versus sixth-endite distinction visible. Distal shaft details are schematic: do not invent a rigidly established extra terminal podomere count.

If included, use two small eyes in posterior gaps between carapace elements, explicitly inferred. Do not add giant anterior eye stalks, a prominent toothed predatory oral cone, walking legs, antennae, a tail fan or tail streamers. A subdued ventral mouth recess may be used only as an acknowledged reconstruction.

scientific_limits.en: Body layout and filtering structures are fossil-informed; exact proportions, living colour, pose and soft tissues remain reconstructed. Eyes are inferred from comparative anatomy and oral-cone details are not established for this species. Fine filtering spinules are omitted and visible setae are deliberately reduced and thickened, not a true mesh-size model. The 2023 six-endite interpretation supersedes the five-long-endite layout of the 2015 reconstruction; the terminal appendage region remains incompletely known. No tail fan is added.
scientific_limits.zh: 体态和滤食结构依据化石，精确比例、活体颜色、姿态及软组织仍属复原。眼睛位置来自比较解剖推断，本种口锥细节尚未确定。微细小刺省略，可见刚毛减少并加粗，不代表真实滤网孔径。附肢采用2023年六条长内叶的新解释，不照搬2015年五条长内叶复原；末端节区仍不完整可知。不添加尾扇。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original static refined-low-poly whole-animal reconstruction of Aegirocassis, informed principally by A. benmoulai from the Early Ordovician Lower Fezouata Shale of Morocco. A representative living animal, not a scan, exact individual replica, or claim of resolved soft anatomy.

taxon.nomenclature_note: Use benmoulai; corrected by Van Roy, Briggs and Gaines in 2015 and retained by Potin et al. in 2023.

views_policy.gray_checks: 3–4 low-cost blockout checks before final polish; private only.
views_policy.preview: May reuse the exact perspective bytes.
views_policy.website_render: No exact website renderer/config has been supplied to this prep. Do not claim website image compliance. Retain standard diagnostic perspective; only generate integration display assets when required by the verified release contract.

visual_acceptance: Front: two separate suspended filtering arrays, open negative space and dorsal/ventral flap height separation; avoid central fused solid grille.
Side: long low forward shield, oval lateral element, hanging curved endites and two distinct flap tiers.
Top: carapace/trunk proportions, 11-part taper, terminal blunt rear without fan, paired rows of separate flaps.
Perspective: all diagnostic features legible together; no accidental collisions, intersecting shell lobes, disconnected bristles or thin-plane disappearance.

description.en: Whole-adult woolly rhinoceros, Coelodonta antiquitatis, combining fossil and permafrost evidence with a substantial oval nasal-horn base. Proportions are approximate, not a cast of one specimen; fur, colour, soft tissue, pose and full horn curvature remain artistic choices.
description.zh: 披毛犀 Coelodonta antiquitatis 成体全身复原，综合化石与冻土材料，鼻角采用厚实椭圆基部。体比例为近似值，非单一标本翻模；毛量、颜色、软组织、姿势与完整角弯度仍属美术选择。

art_direction.construction: Original controlled profile lofts for trunk, cheek, neck and tapered limbs; shaped horn sweeps with ellipse-changing cross sections. Continuous intentional transitions and mixed flat/smooth normals. No untouched sphere/cylinder collage.
art_direction.palette: Muted warm umber body, subdued warm-brown dorsal mane, lighter muzzle/undercoat, charcoal eyes and hooves, warm dark keratin. No speculative stripes or glossy toy finish.
art_direction.target_view: Readable at museum card size, with deliberate medium-range contour detail; no microscopic fidelity claim.
art_direction.texture_policy: No image textures, alpha cards, displacement, particle fur or external bitmap dependencies. Material colors are original design choices, not specimen color claims.

diagnostic_targets: Long heavy trunk and deep chest on short strong legs; raised withers flow into a gently declining back and rounded rump. Avoid a tall elephant-like outline or a hippo body with a pasted-on cone.

Two median keratin horns. The anterior nasal horn is distinctly longer and gently swept backward, with a broad fore-aft oval base, tapering into a compressed distal shaft. The shorter frontal horn is separate and more upright behind it. Both attach to real volumes, never a floating spike.

The main horn base fore-aft-to-transverse ratio is approximately 1.5. Preserve obvious width at attachment and taper; do not flatten the base into a razor blade or copy the broken MM 3074 stump as a whole horn.

An elongated low-carried head with a substantial cheek, tapered neck, blunt muzzle, recessed small lateral eyes and two compact pointed ears set high at the rear of the head. Eyes are not forward-facing predator eyes.
Exactly three short hoofed toes per foot, with a broad middle toe and smaller flanking toes. Four feet have visible clearance, plausible joint transitions and grounded support.

Dense coat conveyed through deliberately faceted body volume, a restrained darker mane/withers region and sparse low-profile fur edge breaks; no thousands of hairs, isolated porcupine cones, fur-covered eyes, or noisy random triangles.
Short tapered tail near the rump, not a long modern-rhino whip. Two-horn/woolly/low-long-trunk combination distinguishes this asset structurally from other rhinoceroses, not by size or palette alone.
frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Quiet grounded quadrupedal stance, head carried low, mouth closed, subtle longitudinal leg staggering to expose all four feet. No extreme action or snow-shoveling claim.

scale.status: Modeling targets, not exact specimen measurements. Published adult females support a roughly 3.2–3.6 m head-body length and 1.45–1.65 m withers height. The selected horns synthesize adult examples rather than replicate the shorter horns of MM 7938.

scientific_limits.en: Body proportions are approximate adult reconstruction targets guided by Kolyma and Starunia measurements, not a cast of one specimen. Horn shape varies and preservation can alter it: the nasal horn has a substantial oval base, not the extremely narrow attachment implied by some older reconstructions. Fur volume, living color, muscle contours, posture and full horn curvature are artistic choices. No sex, exact age, paleocoexistence or current conservation status is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: 体比例是参考科雷马与斯塔鲁尼亚测量数据的成体复原目标，非单一标本翻模。角形有个体差异且可受保存过程改变：鼻角采用厚实椭圆基部，不照搬部分旧复原中极窄的附着基部。毛量、活体颜色、肌肉轮廓、姿势与完整角弯度为美术选择。不声称性别、准确年龄、同域共生关系或现生保护状态。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original whole-adult woolly rhinoceros reconstruction synthesizing named fossil and permafrost evidence. It is not a scan, an exact individual restoration, or a behavioral demonstration.

view_plan.additional_views: Only if a concrete unresolved issue requires one, with a recorded reason.
view_plan.preview: Exact same bytes as perspective permitted.
view_plan.website_delivery: No website render compatibility claim at prep. Keep the four diagnostic views. If the actual verified website renderer/config can also serve perspective adequately, document that substitution before rendering; otherwise integration owns necessary website derivatives.

description.en: Embolotherium andrewsi with a broad frontonasal ram and reconstructed enlarged nasal soft tissue, informed by the type skull and AMNH interpretation. The body is a comparative brontothere reconstruction, not an associated skeleton; skin, ears, proportions and scale are illustrative, without weapon-function or vocal-behaviour claims.
description.zh: 雷兽 Embolotherium andrewsi 参考模式头骨与 AMNH 解释，呈现宽大额鼻突及推定膨大的鼻部软组织。躯体为比较解剖复原，非完整关联骨架；皮肤、耳、比例与尺度为示意，不宣称武器功能或发声行为。

art_direction.hair: No detailed shaggy coat; any sparse short mane is an optional original simplification, not a fossil claim
art_direction.pose: Neutral standing, no base, landscape, labels, props or loose objects
art_direction.style: Refined low-poly, deliberate faceted lofts and broad plane changes, organic transitions; not an assembly of untouched spheres
art_direction.textures: None required; do not embed reference imagery

frozen_scientific_scope.budget_rationale: Target 4500–8500 triangles; spend detail on integrated nose/ram silhouette, cheek and jaw planes, foot separation and limb transitions. The hard caps are practical asset budgets, not anatomical targets. Do not reduce the characteristic nasal mass to meet an arbitrary low triangle count.

delivery_profile.early_self_check: 3–4 low-cost clay views before final rendering
delivery_profile.preview: May be byte-identical to perspective; render from exact exported GLB
delivery_profile.website_images: No early 768x432 image. No claim that the diagnostic perspective satisfies the website renderer/camera contract; integration handles only necessary display derivatives.

dimensions.interpretation: Art-directed large brontothere scale; not measurements of AMNH 26001. Nose top can reach about shoulder height or slightly above in the selected neutral pose.

morphology_targets: Build a massive barrel-bodied graviportal quadruped with a short strong neck, broad shoulders, separated stout limbs, small ears, and a tapering tail. No armor plates, elephant trunk, antlers, tusks or rhino keratin horn.

The defining cranial structure is ONE midline frontonasal ram with a transversely broad, blunt upper rim, continuous with the nasal/forehead mass. Frontal view must read as a broad coherent plate/ridge, never two freestanding Megacerops prongs.

Use the AMNH E. andrewsi side diagram to orient the head: mouth is below the anterior ram, orbit behind it, high occiput behind the eye. Do not mistake the tall posterior occiput for the nasal ram. Preserve a concave/saddle-shaped top line between the anterior upturned nasal region and posterior cranium.

In the living model fill the region beneath the ram with a thick reconstructed nasal/snout volume. No open triangular hole under a bare shield. Blend the nose into the muzzle and cheek; use modest, non-tubular nostrils and a short closed mouth seam below.

Keep a deep jaw and small lateral eye positioned behind the nasal base. A restrained skin-covering palette must carry over the nose/ram, without a contrasting bone-colored exposed horn. The broad top rim and nasal side planes must remain legible from front, side and perspective.

Use flattened multi-toed feet rather than round balls or cloven bovine hooves. Four forefoot digits and three hindfoot digits are comparative brontothere reconstruction choices, with small side digits kept subordinate. Maintain clear floor contact and no interpenetrating toe clusters.

A quiet four-foot weight-bearing stance, head carried slightly forward and up, keeps the diagnostic snout visible. Slight fore/hind stagger is allowed for readability, not an action, battle or vocalization pose.
negative_examples: A flat detached shield perched on a normal rhino nose
Open empty space beneath an exposed nasal blade
Skull with exposed teeth used as a living head
Front and hind legs merged into one mass
review_targets: Single broad integrated nasal ram survives front, side, top and perspective views
Deep fleshed head with correct mouth/eye/occiput relation
Independent four-limb weight support and readable feet
No source-only artifacts, reference images or private paths in exported/public files

scientific_limits.en: The skull constrains the broad single frontonasal ram and deep, saddle-shaped head. AMNH interprets the process as supporting an enlarged nose, not simply an exposed combat horn. Nasal soft-tissue outline, nostril details, ears, hair, skin, coloration, body proportions, and posture remain reconstruction choices. The type skull has distortion and restoration; do not copy every fossil asymmetry. Body size is an approximate presentation scale, not a specimen measurement. No claim about sex, weapon function, vocal behavior, exact locality, or a complete associated skeleton.
scientific_limits.zh: 头骨限定单一宽大额鼻撞槌状突起及深而鞍状的头部；AMNH 将其解释为支撑膨大的鼻部，不应只做成外露战斗角。鼻部软组织轮廓、鼻孔细节、耳、毛、皮肤、颜色、身体比例和姿势仍属复原选择。模式头骨存在变形及修复，不照搬全部不对称。体型数值是近似展示尺度，并非标本实测；不宣称性别、武器功能、发声行为、精确产地或完整关联骨架。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original stylized whole-animal reconstruction of an adult Embolotherium andrewsi, anchored to the AMNH 26001 type skull and AMNH scientific head reconstruction. The body is a comparative brontothere reconstruction, not a complete associated skeleton or scanned specimen. Static neutral standing candidate only.
