description.en: American mastodon, Mammut americanum, with a low elongated head, stocky body and gently upcurved upper tusks, informed by several museum skeletons. Soft tissues, coat and scale are illustrative. Lower tusks are omitted for this adult interpretation, not declared absent throughout the species; diagnostic molars are not exposed.
description.zh: 美洲乳齿象 Mammut americanum 综合多具博物馆骨架，呈现低长头部、粗壮躯体及平缓上弯的上颌长牙。软组织、毛被与尺度为示意。本成体复原不显示下颌长牙，不代表全物种均无此结构；鉴别性臼齿未外露。

acceptance_obligations: Inspect actual exported GLB pixels for all named morphology and craft criteria; names and numeric checks alone are insufficient.
Bind source geometry/export checks, official Khronos validator and exact GLB parse/reimport evidence to final bytes.
Run two isolated deterministic rebuilds and demonstrate semantic geometry/material equivalence with all relative dependencies declared.
Fresh independent visual/factual/specification review must bind actual maker/reviewer identities and hashes. Maker leaves qa/decision.json PENDING.
GPU, populated scene, user acceptance and deployment remain UNKNOWN without their own evidence. Prep readiness and local candidate acceptance do not authorize publication.

art_direction.construction: Use intentional lofted cross sections rather than visible assembled balls and cylinders. Keep the head, neck and shoulders integrated; use smooth decreasing tusk/trunk sections with enough bends to avoid mechanical elbows.
art_direction.ears: Modest rounded lateral ears are artistic soft-tissue choices. Do not enlarge into African-elephant sails or claim precise preserved ear anatomy.
excluded_details: copied museum surface colors or textures
plinth, poles, labels or scenery inside export
art_direction.negative_space: Trunk must separate from both tusks, chest and forefeet. Four legs and tusk roots should remain readable across the standard views; no deep cut seams, hovering feet, detached ears or tusks crossing through the face.
art_direction.tail: Short tapering elephant-like tail with a restrained terminal tuft as an artistic choice; no long feline tail.

frozen_scientific_scope.geometry_budget_rationale: Practical ceilings, not targets. Aim for approximately 4500–8000 emitted triangles. Spend geometry on a low elongated head, coherent shoulder/hip transitions, four separated weight-bearing legs, tapered trunk and continuously curving paired tusks; do not waste it on hair strands or a hidden skeleton.

morphology.basis: Current skeletal images and museum comparative description, with original soft-tissue padding.
morphology.obligation: Keep a forward-elongated head with a relatively broad, low cranial roof and restrained forehead. The face must not have the tall domed, front-to-back compressed mammoth profile. Build a coherent trunk root between and above the tusk roots, not a tube glued below the jaw.

morphology.basis: Inspected modern mounts show substantial upcurvature; comparative text means less twisted than mammoth tusks. Do not copy exaggerated historical replacements.
morphology.obligation: Two thick-rooted tapered upper tusks emerge separately, extend forward and sweep upward in a broad gentle arc. Preserve left/right space around the trunk and visible curved tips; avoid both dead-straight spears and tight inward spiral loops. The inventory term relatively straight is comparative, not literal.

morphology.basis: Skeletal proportions and museum comparison; the fleshed dorsal contour remains interpretive.
morphology.obligation: Deep broad barrel-like torso, robust weight-bearing legs and a long gently rounded back. Shoulders may be modestly higher than the rump, but no exaggerated tall mammoth shoulder hump or steep continuously falling topline. Avoid a perfectly flat plank spine.

morphology.basis: Museum description of broad feet, interpreted as fleshed limbs rather than copied skeletal digits.
morphology.obligation: Four broad rounded feet have credible flattened contact patches. Keep legs robust and separated, with continuous shoulder and hip transitions. Subtle toenails are optional; no exposed splayed skeleton toes on a living reconstruction.

morphology.basis: Combined silhouette requirement, not a claim that this alone proves species-level diagnosis.
morphology.obligation: At thumbnail scale the low long head, deep stocky torso, subdued dorsal slope and non-spiralling upcurved tusks must read together. Do not make a woolly mammoth by only changing the label, color or scale.

original_inventory_identity.selection: Retain the original Mammut entry and its low-head/deep-body/tusk distinction. Species is narrowed to Mammut americanum using named museum evidence, not a switch to Mammuthus or Mammut pacificus.

pose.description: Calm grounded four-foot stance, slightly staggered far legs for readability, long head carried forward at or below shoulder level, relaxed hanging trunk with a modest inward-curved tip, short tail clear of hindfeet. Tusks point forward then curve upward and modestly outward. No rearing, charge, elevated trunk trumpet pose or museum supports.
pose.interpretation: Original stable exhibit pose, not a demonstrated gait or behavior.
pose.mouth: Closed; no exposed molars or speculative dental reconstruction.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependencies. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

scale.basis: Original display proportions. Shoulder height lies within the museum-reported typical 8–10 ft range; all other target dimensions are artistic, not measured from perspective photographs. Preserve real-world scale and do not normalize to a unit cube.

scientific_limits.en: Museum mounts contain restored parts and interpretive poses; historic exaggerated tusks are excluded. Skin, coat color and length, ears, trunk shape, tail and body padding are artistic interpretations. Lower tusks vary in Mammut americanum and are omitted for this late-Pleistocene adult interpretation, not claimed absent in the species or in every reference specimen. Dimensions are illustrative, not measurements of Warren or Fred. The closed mouth does not expose diagnostic molars; species identification rests on the reference context and combined silhouette rather than one external feature.
scientific_limits.zh: 博物馆骨架含修复部件及解释性姿态；历史展示中夸大的长牙不作为依据。皮肤、毛色与毛长、耳、象鼻、尾和躯体软组织均为美术解释。美洲乳齿象下颌长牙存在个体差异，本晚更新世成年复原选择不显示下颌长牙，不代表全物种或全部参考标本均无此结构。尺寸为示意值，并非 Warren 或 Fred 的实测值。闭口模型不展示鉴别性臼齿，物种范围依靠参考背景与组合轮廓，而非单一外形特征。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original static refined-low-poly living reconstruction of an adult Mammut americanum. The named Warren mastodon at AMNH and Fred (Buesching mastodon) at the Indiana State Museum are skeletal comparison anchors; the NHM Hintze Hall mount is supplementary. This is a species-informed composite interpretation, not a scan, fossil replica, or reconstruction of a single measured individual.

surface_profile.materials: Original restrained dark umber/taupe body, subtly lighter underside and inner ear, muted ivory tusks, dark eyes/mouth seam and subdued toenails. Matte portable Principled/glTF materials; no reference pixels copied.
surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.normal_style: Deliberate broad faceted or mixed planes, soft integrated transitions. Suggest a short/moderate coat through contour and color only; no hair cards, strands or unverified long shag blanket.

anatomical_anchors: Warren mastodon, American Museum of Natural History, Newburgh, New York specimen
Fred / Buesching mastodon, Indiana State Museum
Modern American mastodon mount in Hintze Hall, Natural History Museum, London; restored historical assemblage, not treated as a single measured individual
taxon.geographic_context: North America, with eastern North American named museum specimens used as anchors
taxon.individual_scope: Adult interpretation. No exact sex, body mass, exact fossil age or individual identity is asserted.

view_plan.extra_views: None by default; add a local view only for a specific unresolved issue.
view_plan.final_source: Clean import of exact delivered GLB. Perspective and preview may reuse identical bytes.
view_plan.greybox_note: Inspect 3–4 cheap private clay/silhouette views before final renders. Resolve head height, back slope and tusk/trunk separation first.
view_plan.website_reuse: Website renderer/camera configuration has not been verified during prep. Keep canonical QA directions, do not claim website compatibility, and do not produce 768x432 derivatives here.

description.en: Hypothetical whole-animal Megarachne servinei, a non-marine aquatic eurypterid, not a giant spider. Fossils constrain the anterior shield, enlarged first two tergites and partial limbs; posterior body, telson, limb endings, depth and pose are inferred. Colour and the roughly 0.54 m body-length target are reconstruction choices, not complete-specimen measurements.
description.zh: Megarachne servinei 的假说性全身复原，属非海相水生广翅鲎，并非巨型蜘蛛。化石约束前部背甲、增大的前两节背板及部分附肢；后躯、尾剑、足端、体厚与姿势为推测。颜色及约0.54米体长目标属复原选择，非完整标本实测。

acceptance_obligations: Inspect all six diagnostic feature obligations against actual exported GLB views.
Measure actual exported triangles, materials, primitives, dimensions, file bytes and intended ground contacts against this brief.
Run source geometry checks, exact-GLB audit and official Khronos validation; review every warning with a concrete reason.
Run two isolated deterministic rebuilds using only declared relative dependencies and record semantic geometry/material agreement.
Bind current decision evidence, GLB and preview hashes; keep independent reviewer identity separate from maker and mapped privately to actual tasks.
Runtime GPU, populated scene, user acceptance and deployment remain UNKNOWN unless their own evidence exists.
No source reference images, internal locators or private URLs in public files; no hidden dependency on another model directory.

habitat.qualification: Alluvial/lacustrine sedimentology and suggested aquatic sediment-raking. Ecology and the large second-plate function remain uncertain. No environment base is exported.

inventory_corrections: Replace the inventory marine biome/tag inference with qualified non-marine aquatic context.
The second tergite is enlarged relative to posterior segments but is not the widest measured plate: first-tergite epimera span approximately 190 mm versus the second plate approximately 147 mm.
Use the approximately 0.54 m hypothetical total-body estimate, not the obsolete 339 mm supposed-spider body measurement.

morphology.inference_policy: Follow the conservative organization of figure 2, not its drawing as a mesh blueprint. Complete T3-T12 as ten small articulated tergites, largely overlapped anteriorly by the enlarged second plate; show several posteriorly before the telson. Their exact widths, depths and exposed lengths are authored estimates. Do not expose invented chelicerae or palps; conceal that underside region beneath the shield. Foot tips and minor blades are simplified completions, not claimed fossil details.
morphology.original_art_direction: Refined faceted low-poly aquatic arthropod. Deliberate lofted armor and limb profiles, not stacked untouched spheres. Desaturated olive-brown dorsal armor, slightly lighter ribs and rims, darker joints and underside; tiny dark eyes. Symmetrical resting benthic stance with negative space between all eight main limbs. No fur, props, floor slab, dramatic attack pose, or patterned soft-tissue claim.
morphology.pose_policy: At least the posterior three pairs form an unambiguous support footprint. Anterior raking limbs can be close to the floor and slightly forward. Keep the telson low, straight and free from self-intersection. State any final contact exceptions in evidence.
morphology.relief_policy: Use a restrained set of roughly 11 to 15 shallow ribs on tergite 2 and sparse small armor relief accents. Do not duplicate dense fossil surface ornament or introduce hair/spines all over the body. Ribs must remain embedded and not hover above armor.

required_features.fail_if: The anterior projection becomes paired fangs, a separate claw unit, or an extreme unsupported beak.
required_features.feature: Broad, low bell-shaped prosomal shield, wider at rear, with a single continuous modest downturned anterior projection and a median ridge.

required_features.fail_if: A spider-like cluster of eight eyes or huge stalked eyes is added.
required_features.feature: One pair of kidney-shaped lateral eyes beside a small median ocular mound; two tiny ocelli may be suggested on that mound.

required_features.fail_if: The first tergite is absent, replaced by a narrow spider waist, or reduced to an unshaped ring.
required_features.feature: Distinct sutured first tergite with shallow median length and longer leaf-like lateral epimera, immediately behind the prosoma.

required_features.fail_if: It reads as a balloon abdomen, a full fused horseshoe shell, an egg sac, or a smooth unsegmented spider opisthosoma.
required_features.feature: Large near-circular second dorsal plate, with readable shallow fan/radial ribs, overlapping the more slender reconstructed posterior body.

required_features.fail_if: Legs are hair-covered tarantula tubes, broad swimming paddles, giant lobster claws, or a mass of intersecting sticks.
required_features.feature: Four paired conspicuous limbs III-VI, stout low-sided articulated podomeres with expanded joints; modest blade-like projections on anterior pairs.

required_features.fail_if: An upcurled scorpion stinger, spider spinnerets, a crab abdomen, or a claim that the complete tail is preserved is introduced.
required_features.feature: A low tapering segmented posterior extension and straight lance-like telson, clearly treated as comparative reconstruction.

runtime_profile.materials: Opaque Principled/glTF metallic-roughness; metallic 0; mostly rough. Export normals and apply scale without negative determinants.

scale.basis: Holotype dimensions in the electronic appendix anchor the anterior body; total length follows the explicitly hypothetical figure 2, not a newly measured specimen. Pose width and height are original design values.

scientific_limits.en: Only the anterior carapace, enlarged first and second tergites and incomplete appendages are directly constrained. The posterior body, telson, distal limb completions, body depth and pose are inferred; chelicerae and palps are unknown and not exposed. Color is artistic. About 0.54 m is a reconstruction estimate, not a complete specimen measurement. The 2005 reassessment supports a non-marine aquatic setting, not the obsolete spider or a default marine animal.
scientific_limits.zh: 直接约束主要来自前部背甲、增大的第一和第二背板及不完整附肢。后躯、尾剑、足端补全、体厚和姿势均属推测；螯肢与须肢未知，不作外露细节。颜色为美术选择。约0.54米是复原估计，并非完整标本实测。2005年再研究支持非海相水生环境，不能沿用旧巨型蜘蛛形象或默认海生标签。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original stylized, hypothetical whole-organism reconstruction of Megarachne servinei, anchored to CORD-PZ 2110 and the second specimen described by Selden, Corronca and Hünicken (2005). Preserved anterior anatomy is distinguished from inferred posterior anatomy. Not a fossil scan, not a giant spider, and not a claim of complete anatomical knowledge.

temporal_context.locality: Pallero Member, Bajo de Véliz Formation, Santa Rosa II quarry, San Luis Province, Argentina
temporal_context.qualification: Latest Carboniferous, possibly earliest Permian in the primary appendix; no narrower coexistence or precise-date claim.

texture_policy.reason: Original material colors and restrained geometric relief are sufficient; no fossil photos or paper figures enter the asset.

view_plan.early_check: Three or four inexpensive gray-model views before final rendering.
view_plan.preview: Use the same bytes as perspective whenever possible.
view_plan.source: Clean import of final model.glb only; record GLB and render-config hashes.
view_plan.web_display: No extra website image is required at preparation or maker stage. The authoritative website renderer/config has not been verified here. Preserve canonical evidence; integration may later create required site derivatives without changing the frozen model.

description.en: Adult female Mongolarachne jurassica reconstructed from the compressed holotype and revised interpretation. Body depth, colour, eyes, posture, missing leg tips and short palps are inferred; fine plumose setae are simplified. Relationships and web architecture remain uncertain, without implying modern Nephila identity or golden silk.
description.zh: Mongolarachne jurassica 成体雌蛛参考压扁模式化石及修订解释复原。体厚、颜色、眼、姿态、缺失足端与短触肢为推定，细小羽状刚毛已简化。亲缘及网结构仍不确定，不暗示现生 Nephila 身份或金色蛛丝。

construction_notes: Model body masses with deliberate tapered profiles and custom cross sections; use a softly faceted abdomen, a lower carapace and narrow rounded limb sections.
Make the eight leg paths individually readable in top and perspective views. Avoid crossing left/right leg bundles and intersections with the abdomen.
A neutral balanced display stance is a staging convention, not a claim that this spider was a ground runner. A restrained roughly bilateral stance is preferred to copying the fossil death pose.
Keep setal clumps subordinate to joint structure. Combine appropriate setal geometry per semantic limb for export efficiency rather than creating a draw call for each hair.
Preserve fixed budgets; spend geometry on limb articulation, body taper and visible bristle silhouettes rather than microscopic barbs.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Body size follows the female fossil approximately; the pedicel, three-dimensional depth, height and projected leg span are design estimates, not a measured living envelope.

factual_checks.criterion: Public labeling names the female-based living reconstruction, not Nephila as current identity or an exact fossil cast.
Carapace and abdomen keep the frozen footprint ratios and an oval, not spherical, abdomen.
Eight walking legs preserve the 1243 length order and clearly shortened third pair; missing IV segments stay labeled inferred.
No transplantation of elongated male palps; all-pair tibial gaiters remain readable.
No golden-web, resolved-family-affinity or doctored chaoyangensis anatomy is asserted.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-GLB front/side/top/perspective images. Perspective may reuse preview bytes. Source/export audit, Khronos validation, exact-GLB loader check, two isolated semantic rebuilds and fresh independent visual/specification review remain required. GPU, populated-scene, user and deployment states require separate evidence.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Before polish, inspect three or four inexpensive front, side, top and oblique gray views for eight-leg attachment, female proportions, pair-III shortness, pedicel visibility and leg negative space.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: Palette-only, static original geometry; opaque, nonmetallic restrained earth colors; no imported imagery or textures.

shape_gate.en: An oval abdomen and compact forebody surrounded by long bristled legs, with the much shorter third pair retained.
shape_gate.zh: 椭圆腹部与紧凑头胸部四周伸长多毛足，保留显著短小的第三足。

scientific_limits.en: The compressed female fossil constrains selected outlines and lengths, not body depth, color, eyes, life pose or full soft anatomy. Missing distal leg-IV parts and short palps are reconstructed. Fine plumose setae are simplified. Relationships and web architecture remain uncertain; no golden silk or modern Nephila identity is implied. The male is comparative evidence, not a source of female palpal anatomy.
scientific_limits.zh: 雌性压扁化石约束部分轮廓与长度，不能确定体厚、颜色、眼部、活体姿态或完整软组织。第四足缺失远端及较短触肢属复原估计；细小羽状刚毛予以简化。亲缘关系及网结构仍有不确定性，不暗示金色蛛丝或现生 Nephila 身份；雄性仅作比较，不移植其触肢到雌性。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original low-poly adult female reconstruction of Mongolarachne jurassica, informed by holotype CNU-ARA-NN2010008 and the 2013 revision. An interpretive living form, not a fossil cast, exact life appearance, or resolved phylogenetic claim.
shape_requirements: Two main body regions with a visible narrow pedicel: compact forebody and larger non-spherical oval abdomen, widest toward its front and tapering rearward.
Exactly eight walking legs, in four bilateral pairs attached to the cephalothorax, plus two clearly shorter female palps. No leg originates on the abdomen.

Leg length order I > II > IV > III. The third pair is conspicuously shortest and below half the first-pair centerline length. Preserve long slender articulated legs and open negative spaces, not a tarantula-like heavy outline.

Retain visible segment changes and distal tibial bristle gaiters on every leg pair, including III. Gaiters are sparse original tapered tufts, not solid furry sleeves; finer setal microstructure is not claimed.
Small paired chelicerae tuck below the anterior forebody; do not add giant projecting fangs, crustacean claws, antennae, a tail or an abdominal sting.
Use understated anterior cephalic relief without claiming a fossil-derived eye arrangement. Do not add conspicuous invented eye dots.
Female palps must not copy the extremely elongated adult male palps. Do not add a web, golden silk, prey, habitat, slab, labels or display plinth to the exported asset.

taxon_scope.excluded_reference: Mongolarachne chaoyangensis, the altered crayfish identified in 2019
taxon_scope.taxonomic_basis: 2013 recombination; 2011 name Nephila jurassica retained only as historical reference

website_view_plan.reason: Use the standard three-quarter structural view for this thin-legged asset. No verified website renderer/camera contract is supplied at preparation; website derivations belong to later integration.

description.en: Adult Pentecopterus decorahensis with differentiated limbs, compound paddles and a blade-like telson, reconstructed from compressed exuviae. The unpreserved dorsal shield, eyes and metastoma are hypothetical; depth, pose and colour are artistic. The 0.85 m body-length target is a representative adult estimate, not a complete specimen or exceptional maximum; sex remains uncertain.
description.zh: 成体 Pentecopterus decorahensis 依据受压蜕壳复原，保留分化附肢、复合游泳桨与刀片状尾剑。未保存的背盾、眼及口后板属假说；体厚、姿态与颜色为美术选择。0.85米体长目标为代表性成体估计，非完整标本实测或最大值；性别不确定。

acceptance_obligations: Check all seven morphology obligations against the exact-export four views, including actual pair count and regional spine hierarchy.

Measure exported dimensions, triangles, materials, primitives and bytes against this frozen brief; body length excludes projecting anterior limbs. No ground-contact test is implied for the suspended aquatic pose.
Run source geometry checks, exact-GLB audit and official Khronos validation; resolve errors and review each warning.
Run two isolated deterministic rebuilds using only declared package-relative dependencies and record semantic geometry/material agreement.
Use a fresh independent reviewer, actual identities mapped privately, and bind current decision to exact GLB/preview/evidence hashes.
Keep GPU, populated-scene, user and deployment states UNKNOWN without their own evidence.
Exclude primary images, private paths and internal task locators from public output. No undeclared dependency on another model folder.

distinctness.against_eurypterus: Long rostrate head, dominant anterior raptorial pairs, unequal walking limbs and compound sixth-limb blades replace the compact head and more uniform walking limbs. Telson is broad xiphous rather than long needle-like.
distinctness.against_hibbertopterus_and_megarachne: Gracile segmented swimming form with a true paddle pair, not a broad dome with sweep-feeding legs or Megarachne's broad anterior dorsal plate.
distinctness.against_megalograptus: Not a scale or palette variation: elongated rostrate headshield, differently distributed II/III armature, distinctive expanded VI-6 compound paddle, nonexpanded pretelson and complete absence of paired cercal blades.

habitat.environment: Marginal to nearshore aquatic setting, possibly brackish
habitat.qualification: The deposit is interpreted as restricted and low-oxygen within the Decorah impact basin. This does not fix the animal's full habitat range or exact behavior.

morphology.inference_policy: Use a modest low domed dorsal shell. Small reniform lateral eyes and tiny median ocelli may follow the explicitly hypothetical figure 20 and must remain labeled as reconstruction. A discreet ventral metastoma is optional, hypothetical and should not dominate views. Simplify the operculum without claiming sex or type A/B genital anatomy. Do not model exposed internal gills or invented sensory antennae.
morphology.original_art_direction: Refined low-poly marine arthropod with lofted armor and carefully spaced angular limb sections. Use muted umber/olive-brown cuticle, slightly lighter dorsal panels and paddle edges, dark joints and small dark eyes. Color is an artistic choice, unrelated to fossil compression color. Deliberate facets, not an assembly of unmodified spheres. Avoid decorative spikes and excessive microdetail.
morphology.pose_policy: Neutral, approximately bilateral, horizontal aquatic pose. II and III reach forward with ventral spine pairs oriented meaningfully toward the capture space; IV and V angle ventrolaterally, and VI extends out/back with plausible tilted paddle joints. Figure 20 presents limb lateral views rotated into the page, so do not trace all limb planes flat in the top plane. Preserve distinct silhouettes and negative spaces. No unsupported raised threat pose or exact gait claim.
morphology.relief_policy: Only sparse shallow median droplet-scale accents, mild posterior serrations on posterior tergites and restrained paddle-edge denticulation. No taphonomic drying cracks as living texture. Fine sensory setae and dense micro-scales are omitted at this display scale; retain blade geometry instead.

required_features.fail_if: A short semicircular Eurypterus head, giant circular horseshoe shell or huge forward horn replaces the elongate rostrate outline.
required_features.feature: Elongate trapezoidal, low domed headshield with a broad anterior rostral region and shallow central notch. Ventral plate outlines support the perimeter, but not a preserved dorsal shell. Keep the rostral front free of limb insertions; mouth appendages attach beneath the posterior half.

required_features.fail_if: An added walking/paddle pair changes the count, the grasping limbs become pterygotid giant chelicerae, or the two anterior pairs lose their distinct hierarchy.
required_features.feature: Six prosomal appendage pairs total. I are small three-part chelicerae beneath the rostrum, not giant toothed pincers. II are shorter stout anterior raptorial limbs; III are longer forward raptorial limbs with distinct distal fixed spines. II-IV are not interchangeable copied legs.

required_features.fail_if: Long spine pairs fuse into solid mitten shapes, negative spaces vanish, or long spines are arbitrarily placed only on a Megalograptus-like fourth-podomere giant fork.
required_features.feature: Pair II has a conspicuous paired fourth-podomere spine reaching toward the tip. Pair III has eight podomeres, a single spine pair on podomere 3, and fixed lateral spines increasing through podomeres 4-6. The sixth-podomere spines are the longest and flank the slender penultimate section; the actual tip is a short curved spine, not a claw hand.

required_features.fail_if: IV and V become identical smooth tubes, extra giant claws, or a broad filtering fringe.
required_features.feature: IV is a shorter ventrally directed spinose limb with swollen distal podomere margins and several small spine pairs. V is shorter and slender, with much reduced armature, distal denticulation and a small three-point terminal outline. IV-V must remain readable below/beside the head rather than overlap the raptorial silhouette.

required_features.fail_if: The broad sixth-podomere expansion is missing, paddles read as single unjointed ovals, or the whole paddle is copied as a flat rotated diagram without a plausible articulation.
required_features.feature: VI forms paired compound paddles: expanded leaf-like podomere 6 overlapping the more distal blade; podomere 7 elongated with a rounded projecting anterior corner; a small 7a overlap; oval podomere 8 and tiny terminal 9. Preserve at least the conspicuous two-stage overlapping blade silhouette, not one generic oval on a stick.

required_features.fail_if: Segment count is wrong, body becomes Megarachne's enlarged circular second plate, or wide lateral flanges and tail blades are added.
required_features.feature: Twelve opisthosomal segments with a reduced first tergite, near-parallel broad anterior body and gradual posterior taper. Six posterior segments narrow without an abrupt waist; pretelson is about 1.5 times the preceding segment length and does not expand laterally. Low central scale accents may be present, but no raised median ridge or lateral epimera.

required_features.fail_if: Telson becomes a needle, rounded paddle, upcurled scorpion stinger, or Megalograptus-like three-part terminal complex.
required_features.feature: A single broad xiphous, lance/blade-like telson with tapered pointed end, approximate length/maximum width 2.5-3.0, subtle lateral scale accents and no pronounced median keel. No paired cercal blades flank it.

runtime_profile.materials: Opaque portable Principled/glTF metallic-roughness, metallic 0, restrained roughness. Apply scale, avoid negative determinants and export normals.

scale.basis: 0.85 m is a common-size adult reconstruction choice based on the paper. Subdivisions approximate the proportions of figure 20, not independent specimen measurements. Limb span and 3D depth are authored presentation values; target telson length/width remains between 2.5 and 3.0.

scientific_limits.en: The material consists of disarticulated or partly articulated compressed exuviae. Dorsal prosomal shield, eyes and metastoma are unpreserved; their shapes are hypothetical. Depth, pose and colors are artistic. The selected 0.85 m carapace-to-telson length is a representative reconstruction within the authors' 0.75-1.00 m common adult estimate, not an exact specimen measurement or the exceptional 1.70 m estimate. Genital type and sex remain uncertain. Figure 20 rotates limbs into lateral views and is not a literal flat life pose.
scientific_limits.zh: 材料为分离或部分相连、受压保存的蜕壳。前体背盾、眼和口后板未保存，其形状属假说；体厚、姿势与颜色为美术补配。所选背盾前端至尾剑末端0.85米，是论文常见成体0.75至1.00米估计范围内的代表性复原值，并非完整标本实测或最大1.70米估计。生殖附肢类型及性别不确定。图20将附肢旋转为侧视展示，不能照搬为全部平铺的活体姿势。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original adult whole-organism reconstruction of Pentecopterus decorahensis, synthesized from the same-species cuticular fossils and explicitly hypothetical reconstruction of Lamsdell et al. (2015). Preserve differentiated appendages, compound paddles and a blade-like telson. Not a scan, a juvenile, or a complete single specimen.

temporal_context.locality: Winneshiek Shale, Winneshiek Lagerstaette, near Decorah, Iowa, USA
temporal_context.qualification: No newly claimed exact numerical age or association with every Ordovician animal.

texture_policy.reason: Original muted materials and sparse shallow geometric relief suffice. No reference images are embedded or used as textures.

view_plan.early_check: Three or four inexpensive grayscale blockout views before final rendering; ensure limb count, spine separation, compound paddles and telson shape read.
view_plan.preview: Use the same bytes as perspective where possible.
view_plan.source: Clean import of the exact delivered model.glb. Bind images to GLB and render-configuration hashes.
view_plan.web_display: No extra website image at prep/maker stage. The authoritative site renderer/config was not verified here; integration may create necessary derivatives later without rewriting frozen QA images.

description.en: Thylacoleo carnifex, the marsupial lion, in a neutral whole-body stance based on composite fossil anatomy. Soft tissues, coat, ears, colour and size are interpretive; the missing hind-foot hallux tip is conservatively completed. Climbing and tail-bracing remain functional hypotheses, not observed behaviour or a depicted hunting event.
description.zh: 袋狮 Thylacoleo carnifex 综合化石解剖作中性站姿全身复原。软组织、毛被、耳、颜色及尺寸为解释性补配；缺失的后足拇趾末端作保守补全。攀爬与尾支撑仍属功能推断，不代表已观察行为或特定捕猎事件。

art_direction.budget_rationale: Target roughly 6500-11000 triangles; 16000 is a practical ceiling for digit/claw readability and shoulder flow, not a fill target. The 48-primitive ceiling allows editable semantic groups; merge compatible export surfaces where useful without losing editability.
art_direction.construction: Continuous profile lofts for torso/neck/tail and a deliberately shaped broad head. Use section transitions at shoulders, haunches, elbows and wrists. Primitive starting meshes may be heavily reshaped but untouched ellipsoids/cylinders may not constitute the animal.
geometry_priority: Four grounded paws and limb separation
art_direction.surface: Controlled, unevenly spaced facets along designed anatomical planes; primarily matte earth colors with a quieter belly region. No stripes, spots, wet/plastic skin or glossy oversized cartoon eyes.

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Marsupialia, Diprotodontia, Thylacoleonidae; not a felid.

diagnostic_targets.target: Short, wide, deep cheek region and blunt muzzle; inset eyes and a continuous head-neck transition. No doglike long snout, felid saber canines or lion mane.
Robust braced chest and powerful forearms, with anatomical elbow/wrist transitions rather than exposed sphere joints. Four limbs and belly clearance remain readable.
Each forepaw has four smaller fingers plus the separate medial thumb bearing one enlarged curved claw. Thumb claws must be visibly larger, not claws on the outer wrist or on every digit.
Relatively firm lower back and muscular tapering tail; no long thin feline whip, bushy tuft or repeated beads.
Hindfeet use a low plantigrade pad, slender digits II-V with II/III paired closely, and a small divergent medial hallux restored bluntly. Do not copy the forepaw thumb-claw onto the hindfeet.
Nearly closed mouth, optionally parted slightly to reveal restrained incisors; avoid an invented complete dental display. Short coat and rounded ears remain understated artistic inferences.

frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Quiet, low-headed, weight-bearing quadrupedal stance with slight fore-aft paw staggering. Hind heels are lowered. Tail extends back with a thick stable base, restrained distal descent and no tight curl. No tree, rock, prey, scene props, mane or display pedestal.

scale.status: Illustrative adult-size design targets, not measurements of a particular fossil
scale.tolerance: Approximately 10 percent around artistic dimensions if needed for coherent anatomy; record any intentional change.

scientific_limits.en: Fossil anatomy is separated from inferred soft tissue, coat, color, ear shape and pose. The pedal hallux tip is missing in the cited specimens; a small blunt reconstruction is inferred, not observed. Climbing and tail-bracing are functional hypotheses, not witnessed behavior. This asset shows a neutral stance, not a claimed hunting event. Published museum size summaries and reconstructed skeletal proportions do not define an exact same-individual scale.
scientific_limits.zh: 化石解剖与软组织、毛被、颜色、耳形及姿态推定分开。所引足部标本缺少后足拇趾末端，小钝趾为保守补全而非直接观察。攀爬及尾支撑为功能推断，并非已观察行为。本件采用中性站姿，不复现特定捕猎事件。博物馆尺寸概述与复原骨架比例不能视为同一个体的精确尺寸。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original, whole-organism, refined low-poly reconstruction of the Pleistocene Australian marsupial Thylacoleo carnifex. Composite anatomical interpretation, not a fossil scan or one measured individual.

texture_policy.reason: Silhouette and tailored faceting carry this model; no copied photo texture or fur microgeometry.

view_plan.final: Four exact-delivered-GLB views; perspective and preview may be identical bytes. Only add a local detail if a specific claw or contact issue is invisible in these views.
view_plan.website: No additional site images in prep or maker by default. Actual website renderer/config compatibility must be verified before claiming reuse; no guessed camera substitution.

description.en: Callichimaera perplexa. Colour, inflated soft volume and chosen resting/swimming pose are interpretive. No arbitrary enlarged eyes beyond source proportions; distal leg lamellae follow fossil/reconstruction evidence. Sex-neutral simplified pleon, no claim of reproductive microanatomy.
description.zh: Callichimaera perplexa 的活体复原。颜色、软组织体积和静止或游泳姿态为解释；足端薄片参考化石与复原证据，腹部作性别中性的简化，不表现繁殖微解剖。

acceptance_obligations: Distinct animal silhouette and anatomical brief compliance in four exact-GLB views.
Portable embedded GLB, source reopening and scoped technical checks; independent review separate.
Mark GPU, world scene, user acceptance and deployment unverified until actually checked.

art_direction.construction: Original coherent lofts, controlled tapered appendages and readable negative space; no floating parts or mechanically stacked primitives.

frozen_scientific_scope.geometry_budget_rationale: Ceilings only, not density targets. Spend geometry on diagnostic anatomy and continuous attachments; no hidden microdetail.

morphology.obligation: Fusiform carapace distinctly longer than wide, cervical and branchiocardiac grooves and axial ridge; not a generic wide modern crab.
Very large subglobular compound eyes on short peduncles with no enclosing orbit, bifid rostrum and two small antennal pairs between eyes.
One pair P1 stout spanner-like claws, fixed finger deflected about90 degrees, paired mobile dactyl. No three-finger claw.
Exactly two large oar-like limb pairs P2 and P3, flattened distal propodus/dactylus.
Exactly two reduced narrow posterior pairs P4 and P5, subdorsal, directed back; P5 smallest. These are not paddles, pincers or shell-carrying hooks.
Readable ventral pediform third maxillipeds plus symmetrical segmented pleon with small telson, no uropods or shrimp tail fan. Simplify hidden microanatomy honestly.

pose.description: Gentle static swimming or spread-limb pose preserving two paddle pairs and two reduced rear leg pairs. No substrate, no shell carried, no extra tail fan.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependencies. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

description.en: Tokummia katalepsis. Fossil compression does not preserve exact living depth. Shell thickness, body padding, color, joint angles and pose are interpretations. Head homologies and phylogenetic placement remain researched questions; follow the cited museum interpretation without claiming certainty. Reduced or absent eyes are unresolved: omit prominent eyes, not claim proven blindness. Exact dimensions and limb counts below are modeling conventions, not specimen measurements.
description.zh: Tokummia katalepsis 的示意性活体复原。壳厚、体厚、颜色、关节角度和姿态为解释，头部同源性及亲缘位置仍有研究空间；不突出眼睛并不等于证实失明，尺寸及肢数约定不视为标本实测。

acceptance_obligations: All five morphology obligations must be judged from actual final-GLB pixels and, where occluded, the editable geometry or a specific cheap private diagnostic view. Labels and numeric counts do not establish anatomy.
Bind source/export measurements, Khronos validation, exact GLB parsing/reimport and preview manifest to final hashes. Preserve centimeter-scale dimensions in meters.
Run two isolated deterministic rebuilds with semantic geometry/material equivalence and declared dependencies.
Independent visual/factual/specification review must use actual reviewer identity and fresh hash-bound evidence. Maker decision remains PENDING until that review.
GPU rendering, populated world, user acceptance and deployment remain UNKNOWN until separately tested. Brief readiness grants no upload, Git, publication or deployment authority.

art_direction.construction: Author original lofted surfaces and jointed tapered sections. Retain two shell volumes, central trunk and attached paired limb arrays as editable semantic parts. Preserve living volume; never trace the compressed fossils into flat cards.
excluded_details: only five modern decapod walking-leg pairs
solid feather/skirt substitute for limb geometry
museum reference textures or copied artwork
fossil substrate, plinth, lights or cameras in export
art_direction.negative_space: Separate both grasping claws from shell rims and antennae; prevent walking legs or repeated paddles from intersecting their neighbors. Close only accidental holes, not the intentional ventral opening.
art_direction.palette: Original subdued slate-teal shell, muted warm grey/ochre appendages and a slightly lighter underside. Museum artwork colors are not evidence and are not copied.

frozen_scientific_scope.geometry_budget_rationale: Ceilings, not targets. Spend triangles on valve curvature, negative space within the pincers, anterior articulations, rear limb rhythm and paired rami. Batch repeated geometry into a small number of semantic exported mesh groups so limb count does not force one GLB primitive per limb. Do not model microscopic setae or a hidden detailed digestive system.

maker_handoff.environment: Current authorized cloud only; follow the project-required modeling runtime and model before starting Blender.
execution_order: Probe Blender/exporter and consuming runtime versions; freeze brief and reference hashes.
Build shell/trunk/pincers/paired tail before dense secondary limbs. Inspect four low-cost greybox views.

Parameterize approximately 50 paired trunk stations, with 50 as a declared approximation, not an observed exact fossil count; use a transition to broader posterior flaps informed by the source. Record the counting convention including or excluding the grasping pair, and do not silently omit whole limb classes.
Resolve silhouette, attachment and negative space; then add modest superficial mouthparts and original palette.
Save editable source plus deterministic generator/config and declared relative dependencies. Export only the asset; then validate and cleanly reimport the exact final GLB.
Create only the four canonical final views and preview; allow a specific private close-up only to resolve an actual issue. Queue fresh independent review.
maker_handoff.start_state: Brief ready only; no Blender generation or acceptance has occurred.

morphology.basis: Fossil shell outlines plus explicitly interpretive depth from technical and life reconstructions.
morphology.obligation: Broad, rounded/lobate left and right carapace valves connect along the dorsal line and shelter much of the body. Build curved three-dimensional shells with thin visible edges, an open underside and a readable anterior aperture; do not flatten into a butterfly or seal into one clam pebble.

Two articulated maxillipeds project forward, distinct from the antennules and walking legs. Each ends in a comparatively slender open pincer: the fixed finger has two terminal teeth and the opposing finger curves inward. Preserve the opening and joint sequence; avoid huge modern-lobster crusher claws.

morphology.basis: Museum identification and technical drawing; simplified superficial mouthparts only, no invented internal mechanism.
morphology.obligation: One pair of short, stout, segmented antennules; small anterior triangular cover over a paired-lobed organ, not a pair of eyeballs. Underneath, retain modest paired mandibular forms and the following small mouthpart pairs. Omit unsupported stalked eyes and long second antennae.

morphology.basis: Museum description reports about 50 trunk limb pairs, with flap enlargement beginning around trunk limb pair 9; fine segmentation need not be resolved from distant views.
morphology.obligation: Long tubular segmented trunk continues behind the valves. Preserve the dense repeated paired-limb rhythm: robust anterior walking branches end in claws; posterior lobate branches form a diminishing paddle fringe. Keep the walking and flap branches distinct rather than replacing the animal with a few shrimp legs or a solid skirt.
Taper the rear trunk into a small terminal plate and two separate narrow caudal rami. The fork must be visible in side or perspective and top views; no broad fish tail, scorpion sting or lobster fan.

original_inventory_identity.selection: Retain the inventory animal and its paired carapace/long trunk/frontal pincer distinction; narrow the genus entry to the museum-supported Tokummia katalepsis, not a different bivalved arthropod.

pose.description: Neutral near-bottom stance with the trunk approximately horizontal, slight relaxed posterior curvature, anterior walking claws touching the datum, and both grasping limbs forward with modestly open pincers. Short antennules remain clear of the pincers. Keep the tail fork unobscured.
pose.interpretation: A stable display pose, not a reconstructed gait, prey capture, or proven swimming posture. No prey, water, seabed, fossil slab, support or label inside the export.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependencies. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

scale.basis: Illustrative 12 cm animal, compatible with the 2017 ROM account of extended length over 10 cm and the current account reporting a maximum around 15 cm. Not a measurement of either pictured specimen. Never enlarge the source GLB to fit a gallery; display magnification belongs to the viewer.
scale.measurement_convention: Approximate full longitudinal extent in neutral extended pose, including the anterior pincer reach and paired terminal rami. Record actual exported bounds separately.

scientific_limits.en: Fossil compression does not preserve exact living depth. Shell thickness, body padding, color, joint angles and pose are interpretations. Head homologies and phylogenetic placement remain researched questions; follow the cited museum interpretation without claiming certainty. Reduced or absent eyes are unresolved: omit prominent eyes, not claim proven blindness. Exact dimensions and limb counts below are modeling conventions, not specimen measurements.

assets.scope: standalone scoped candidate; formal GPU/composed scene NOT_RUN
reconstruction_notes: Skull lateral depth and tooth-size contrast informed by BMNH41212; BMNH43486 separate mandible; R1034 separate partial postcranium. BSP1994I51 excluded.
Three free manual digits plus one elongate wing-support digit on each forelimb are conservative pterosaur reconstruction, not a digit census from supplied slab.
Five pedal digits per foot: four shorter forward grasping toes and one longer posterolateral fifth; explicit artistic restoration independently reviewable, not measured from R1034.

Pose, proportions, skull breadth, living skin, eye and nostril placement, tail curve/length, membrane, palette and display dimensions are artistic. No preserved pigment, complete tail or habitual behavior claim.
No crest, feathers, naked fenestra holes, detached avian wing pair, ornamental tail vane, platform or copied fossil displacement.
Consulted source pixels and third-party geometry/textures are excluded; all target mesh vertices and palette materials authored by this generator.
